detail.title: An Estimation of the Contribution of the Foreign Population in Spain to GDP per Capita Growth in the Period 2022-2024

publicationDetails.journalName: Banco de Espana Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Migratory flows to Spain have been particularly strong following the pandemic, contributing to the growth of GDP and employment in the Spanish economy. This article estimates the contribution of the foreign population to GDP per capita growth in Spain between 2022 and 2024 and quantifies the channels through which it was made. Takeaways • GDP per capita in Spain grew at an annual average rate of 2.9% between 2022 and 2024. • Based on a mechanical decomposition, the foreign population made an average direct contribution to GDP per capita growth of between 0.4 percentage points (pp) and 0.7 pp. • This contribution is similar, in relative terms, to that estimated in prior upswings and was mainly shaped by two factors: the headway in the assimilation-in different dimensions-of the immigrants who entered Spain in the early 2000s and the improvements in the education level and the occupational distribution of those who have arrived in recent years.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Columbia Business School Research Paper Forthcoming

detail.abstract: Pre-experiment stratification, or blocking, is a well-established technique for designing more efficient experiments and increasing the precision of the experimental estimates. However, when researchers have access to many covariates at the experiment design stage, they often face challenges in effectively selecting or weighting covariates when creating their strata. This paper proposes a Generative Stratification procedure that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to synthesize high-dimensional covariate data to improve experimental design. We demonstrate the value of this approach by applying it to a set of experiments and find that our method would have reduced the variance of the treatment effect estimate by 10%-50% compared to simple randomization in our empirical applications. When combined with other standard stratification methods, it can be used to further improve the efficiency. Our results demonstrate that LLM-based simulation is a practical and easy-to-implement way to improve experimental design in covariate-rich settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型的生成式分层方法，通过合成高维协变量数据来改进实验设计，在实证应用中可将处理效应估计的方差降低10%-50%。

AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种实用且易于实施的实验设计改进方法，特别适用于协变量丰富的环境。

detail.abstract: This impact paper suggests how consumer industries could take social responsibility into their own hands and increase overall sustainability in this sector. We illustrate our idea through the dairy industry to showcase how companies could act at the interface between consumers and producers with the purpose of encouraging more sustainable consumption. More specifically, we outline how innovative participative pricing mechanisms, with the help of sustainable prices (i.e., including the costs for social and environmental sustainability), can be used to encourage consumers to mitigate the consumption of less sustainable products or to shift their preferences towards a more sustainable alternative in general.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Management and Labour Studies, volume 39, issue 1, 2014[10.1177/0258042X14535163]

detail.abstract: The tremendous increase of the use of mobile phones in Bangladesh by the young users has expanded the cellular phones market that has also attracted the attention of the foreign investors. This article attempts to investigate underlying sets of consumer motives for using cellular phones in Bangladesh. A primary survey was conducted among 157 young Bangladeshi mobile phone users aged from 20 to 30 years reside in Dhaka city. Structured questionnaire was used to interview the respondents. Factor analysis was conducted to identify the factors for using cellular phones in Bangladeshi young mobile phone users. Results show that there are five important factors that are considered by the Bangladeshi young mobile phone users. The factors are concerned with value added services, social connectivity, connection with the family, obtaining information on foreign education and facing emergency situation. This study also identified five different patterns of possible segmentation of cellular phone users that is, conscious, connective, communicative, continental and contingent and constitute the basis for strategic positioning.

detail.title: The Impact of Social Media Marketing on Brand Awareness, Brand Engagement and Purchase Intention in Emerging Economies
detail.abstract: Purpose-Purpose. Based on the Uses and Gratifications Theory (UGT), theory of consumer brand engagement (CBE), and empirical findings, we examine the impact of social media marketing (SMM) on brand awareness (BA), consumer brand engagement (CBE), and purchase intention in emerging economies. Design/methodology/approach-Data were collected in North Macedonia, Albania, Kosovo, Romania, and Ukraine from 1808 social media users, through a self-administered online survey. Partial least square structural equation modeling was used to assess the theoretical model, and a multi-group analysis to explore the differences between countries. Findings-Social media marketing has a positive impact on brand awareness, brand engagement, and purchase intention, while country moderates the relationship between brand engagement and purchase intention. We reveal differences among countries regarding SMM's impact on brand engagement and purchase intention. Practical implications-The study promotes SM's impact on brand communications, providing consumer insights that help companies design effective SMM strategies, using similarities and differences in emerging economies. The different levels of CBE and their different influences on purchase intention require a focus on the motivations for brand engagement in social media and the type of content preferred by consumers in each country. The originality of our research lies in our examination of the impact of social media marketing on consumer behavior in five emerging countries. Additionally, we are investigating how the country of origin influences the relationship between social media marketing, brand awareness, consumer behavior, and purchase intention in different countries. Originality/value-The originality of our research lies in our examination of the impact of social media marketing on consumer behavior in five emerging countries. Additionally, we are investigating how the country of origin influences the relationship between social media marketing, brand awareness, consumer behavior, and purchase intention in different countries.

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved voluntary survey participation with informed consent obtained from all respondents. No sensitive personal data was collected, and ethics approval was not required under institutional guidelines.

detail.abstract: Generation Z is set to become the most entrepreneurial generation in human history, in no small part thanks to their unique relationship with digital technologies. Unlike past generations, Gen Z entrepreneurs are not using mainstream sources of startup capital, brick-and-mortar storefronts, or comprehensive business plans. Instead, they are utilizing social media platforms as a marketplace and engine of growth. In this paper, we investigate how social media brings low entry costs for Gen Z entrepreneurs and focuses in particular on the twin capabilities of low-cost access and real consumer interaction. Using a mixed-methods approach-questionnaires of Gen Z consumers in Dubai (n = 120) supplemented with case studies of businesses-founding TikTok and Instagram-the inquiry yields the finding that social media gives entrepreneurs rapid awareness, sales generation through low outlay, and communities of their brand formation. Yet challenges remain in sustaining growth due to platform algorithmic volatility, saturation in competition, and scalability issues beyond the virtual world. Contributing to nascent scholarship, the paper sheds light on how Gen Z entrepreneurship reshapes early-stage business creation and offers implications for policymakers, investors, and educators.

declarations.declarationOfInterest: All authors declare that they have no personal or financial relationships with individuals or organizations that could inappropriately influence, or be perceived to influence, the conduct or outcomes of this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this case study. Written informed consent to participate and for publication of anonymized details was obtained from the participant(s).
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: As the largest employer in the Philippines, the Department of Education (DepEd) plays a critical role in shaping equitable and efficient public service systems, especially in teacher recruitment. In response to longstanding concerns regarding transparency and efficiency in hiring, the DepEd Bohol Division implemented a reformed recruitment and selection system for the 2024-2025 and 2025-2026 hiring cycles. This study evaluated the system's effectiveness as experienced by teacher applicants, focusing on four dimensions: process efficiency, fairness, usability of the applicant portal, and overall satisfaction. Grounded in Strategic Human Resource Management, Organizational Justice Theory, and the Technology Acceptance Model, the study used a descriptive-evaluative design to analyze data from 902 valid survey responses. The instrument, which yielded a Cronbach's alpha of 0.88, underwent pilot testing to ensure internal reliability. Descriptive statistics revealed high ratings across all indicators: efficiency (M = 4.32, SD = 8.00), fairness (M = 4.23, SD = 8.49), portal usability (M = 4.24, SD = 8.77), and satisfaction (M = 4.30, SD = 8.47), with an overall mean of 4.27. A z-test showed no significant difference in ratings between the 2024 and 2025 cycles (p = 0.14), indicating consistent implementation. However, ANOVA results revealed statistically significant differences in perceptions based on the number of application attempts (p = 0.001) and current employment status (p = 0.012), suggesting disparities in experience among repeat applicants and those outside the DepEd system. Other demographic variables showed no significant variation in ratings. While the system was perceived as highly effective overall, the voluntary and non-randomized nature of the sample presents a limitation in generalizability. Nonetheless, the findings underscore the system's strengths in efficiency and fairness, while calling attention to the need for greater inclusivity and responsiveness to underrepresented voices in the applicant pool. The study provides empirical evidence that may guide other divisions and national policymakers in refining recruitment systems toward more meritocratic, transparent, and applicant-centered practices.

title: Real Effects of Bernanke-Kuttner: The Risk Channel of Monetary Policy Announcement on Corporate Investment
affiliations: Vienna Graduate School of Finance (VGSF)

detail.title: Real Effects of Bernanke-Kuttner: The Risk Channel of Monetary Policy Announcement on Corporate Investment
detail.abstract: The literature extensively documents that monetary policy announcements convey information that affects risk premia and investors' risk perceptions, yet little is known about how these shifts influence real activity. Exploiting aggregate news shocks (decomposed into policy rate, growth, and risk components) identified from price changes across asset classes during the FOMC announcement window, I provide plausibly causal evidence that news that increases perceived cash flow risk reduces subsequent corporate investment in tangible capital, with effects amplified among firms with a high debt burden. The results hold after controlling for policy rate surprises, isolating non-policy announcement risk news. Consistent with a flight to quality mechanism in credit markets, announcement risk increasing news raises external finance costs for firms with a high debt burden. These firms curtail net borrowing and build precautionary cash buffers, and their investment cuts are sharper and concentrated when debt maturities are short-i.e., when rollover risk is high. At the aggregate level, the investment response to announcement risk news is state dependent: it is larger when the fraction of firms with high rollover risk is higher. Unconditionally, the effect is statistically insignificant because these firms account for a small share of the tangible capital stock and therefore, on average, contribute little to aggregate investment.

AI.findings: 增加感知现金流风险的风险新闻会减少企业实物资本投资，对高负债企业影响更大；风险增加新闻会提高高负债企业的外部融资成本；这些企业减少净借款并建立预防性现金缓冲；投资削减在债务期限较短时更明显；总体投资对风险新闻的反应具有状态依赖性。

title: Classifying Culture: Typologies and Taxonomies
affiliations: Professional Website

detail.title: Classifying Culture: Typologies and Taxonomies
detail.abstract: This chapter examines the diverse typologies and taxonomies scholars and practitioners have used to classify organizational culture. It traces the evolution of thinking about culture as a system of shared meanings, values, and practices, highlighting how different models have attempted to simplify, categorize, and make culture more measurable. Key frameworks such as Deal and Kennedy's corporate cultures, Cameron and Quinn's Competing Values Framework, Hofstede's cultural dimensions and Trompenaars' cultural orientations are explored, with attention to their strengths, limitations, and applications. The chapter emphasizes that no single taxonomy fully captures the complexity of organizational culture, but comparative use of these models offers valuable tools for leaders seeking to diagnose, interpret, and strengthen their cultures.

AI.tldr: 本章回顾了组织文化分类的多种类型学和方法论，探讨了主要框架如Deal和Kennedy的企业文化模型、Cameron和Quinn的竞争价值观框架、Hofstede的文化维度以及Trompenaars的文化导向，强调没有单一分类法能完全捕捉组织文化的复杂性，但比较使用这些模型为领导者提供了诊断和加强文化的宝贵工具。
AI.research_question: 学者和实践者如何分类组织文化？不同分类方法的优缺点和应用价值是什么？
AI.motivation: 组织文化作为共享意义、价值观和实践的系统，其复杂性需要系统化的分类方法来理解和测量，为领导者提供实用的诊断工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: Deal和Kennedy的企业文化模型、Cameron和Quinn的竞争价值观框架、Hofstede的文化维度理论、Trompenaars的文化导向理论
AI.method: 文献综述和理论框架比较分析，追溯组织文化分类思想的演变过程
AI.findings: 没有单一的分类法能够完全捕捉组织文化的复杂性，但比较使用多种模型可以提供更全面的诊断视角；不同框架各有其优势和局限性，适用于不同的组织情境。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了组织文化分类理论的发展脉络，比较了主要分类框架的理论基础和应用价值，为理解组织文化复杂性提供了理论整合视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织领导者提供了实用的文化诊断工具包，帮助他们通过比较使用不同模型来更准确地解释、诊断和加强组织文化。

detail.abstract: The thesis advanced here is that today the competitive advantage of the enterprise in most industries is rooted in the ability to motivate experts to create knowledge, help build organizational capabilities, and help shape strategy. If combined with good intellectual property protection, control over specialized assets, and a good business model, collective efforts at knowledge creation and renewal can help the enterprise build durable competitive advantage over rival firms.

AI.tldr: 企业竞争优势来源于激励专家创造知识、建立组织能力和塑造战略的能力，结合知识产权保护、专业资产控制和良好商业模式，可构建持久竞争优势。
AI.research_question: 企业如何通过知识创造和组织能力建设获得持久竞争优势？
AI.motivation: 在当今大多数行业中，传统的竞争优势来源已不足以维持企业长期竞争力，需要探索新的竞争优势构建机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于知识创造理论、组织能力理论和竞争优势理论，强调专家知识创造在竞争优势构建中的核心作用。
AI.method: 理论分析框架，通过逻辑推理构建概念模型。
AI.findings: 企业竞争优势根植于激励专家创造知识、帮助建立组织能力和塑造战略的能力，结合知识产权保护、专业资产控制和良好商业模式，可以构建持久竞争优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了以知识创造为核心的竞争优势理论框架，强调专家知识创造在竞争优势构建中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了构建持久竞争优势的实践路径：激励专家知识创造、加强知识产权保护、控制专业资产、优化商业模式。

title: AI Syntactic Power and Legitimacy: How AI Structures Shape Power
affiliations: Universidad de la Republica

detail.title: AI Syntactic Power and Legitimacy: How AI Structures Shape Power
detail.abstract:
This book consolidates a cycle of research on the structural foundations of authority in artificial intelligence. It brings together a series of peer-reviewed articles that demonstrate how power in AI systems no longer depends on meaning, interpretation, or intention, but on syntactic sufficiency.

The argument develops in fourteen chapters, beginning with the autonomy of sense beyond reference and culminating in the colonization of temporality by predictive infrastructures. Along the way, it formalizes a set of theoretical contributions: the regla compilada as a Type 0 grammar of executable authority, the figure of the soberano ejecutable as operator of legitimacy without subject, the theorem of Disconnected Syntactic Authority (DSAT), the theorem of the Limit of Conditional Obedience (TLOC), the δ [E] → ∅ rule of ethical trace deletion, and the formalization of compiled norms as computable legal speech.

AI.tldr: 本书通过14章系统阐述了AI系统中权威的结构基础，论证了AI权力不再依赖于意义、解释或意图，而是基于句法充分性。提出了多个理论贡献，包括可执行权威的Type 0语法、无主体合法性操作者、断开句法权威定理等。
AI.research_question: AI系统中的权威和权力是如何在结构上建立的？它们是否仍然依赖于传统的意义、解释和意图？
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统在社会中的广泛应用，理解AI权威的结构基础变得至关重要，特别是当这些系统开始自主运作并影响人类决策时。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于句法理论、形式语言理论、计算语言学和法律形式化理论，构建了AI权威的结构分析框架。
AI.method: 理论分析和形式化建模，通过14章的系统论证，提出了多个定理和形式化概念。
AI.findings: AI系统中的权力确实不再依赖于意义、解释或意图，而是基于句法充分性；预测性基础设施正在殖民时间性；可执行权威可以通过Type 0语法形式化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了regla compilada（编译规则）、soberano ejecutable（可执行主权者）、断开句法权威定理（DSAT）、条件服从极限定理（TLOC）、伦理痕迹删除规则δ[E]→∅，以及编译规范的形式化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解AI系统的权威运作提供了理论工具，有助于设计更透明和负责任的AI系统，对AI治理和监管具有重要启示。

title: Drug-cost Decision-support at Prescribing (DDP): Early Experiences and Research Directions
affiliations: University of California, Davis, Case Western Reserve University and Gemini Health, Inc

detail.title: Drug-cost Decision-support at Prescribing (DDP): Early Experiences and Research Directions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We confirm that there is no financial support for this project. The company that provided the data for this study did not offer any financial support, and the authors declare no conflict of interest. No other disclosures were reported. We're deeply grateful to several members of the Gemini Health team for enabling this research, especially Dr. Edward Fotsch and Heidi Miller.

detail.abstract: Information technologies are vital for addressing the ills affecting healthcare in the US, including high costs, variable outcomes, and significant inequities. One category of transformative technologies is price transparency and decision support tools for prescription drug choice, which currently operates under a fog of price opacity. This leads to avoidably high spending, even for competitive generic drugs, non-adherence to medication, and poor health outcomes. We present findings from a widely implemented drug-cost decision-support system at prescribing (DDP) that, within the prescription workflow, provides out-of-pocket cost information and identifies cost-effective, therapeutically equivalent alternatives and fulfillment options reflecting the patient's benefits status and pharmacy coverage. Using transactional and claims data from this system, covering 229,193 prescribers, 1.166 million patients, and 6.504 million visits during 2023, we find evidence of positive impact: lower-cost alternative drugs were identified 24.824% of the time, but with an average switch rate of just 3.698% (after excluding simple same-drug brand-to-generic switches that typically occur at the pharmacy counter). These switches reduce total costs (payer plus patient) by 15.475% relative to an opportunity of 30.861% (for patients' share, the savings opportunity was 61.982%, with 20.256% realized). We discuss research directions for deeper investigation of these relationships and better designs that can generate greater effectiveness, savings, and improved health outcomes.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了处方药成本决策支持系统(DDP)的效果，该系统在处方流程中提供药品自付费用信息并推荐成本效益更高的治疗等效替代方案。研究发现系统识别低成本替代药物的比例为24.824%，但实际转换率仅为3.698%，这些转换使总成本降低了15.475%。
AI.research_question: 处方药成本决策支持系统在识别和促进低成本替代药物使用方面的效果如何？
AI.motivation: 美国医疗保健系统面临高成本、结果差异大和显著不平等问题，处方药价格不透明导致不必要的支出、药物不依从性和不良健康结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于价格透明度和决策支持工具的理论框架，强调在处方工作流程中提供实时成本信息和替代方案的重要性。
AI.method: 使用2023年覆盖229,193名处方医生、116.6万患者和650.4万次就诊的交易和索赔数据分析。
AI.findings: 系统识别低成本替代药物的比例为24.824%，实际转换率为3.698%，总成本降低15.475%（相对于30.861%的机会），患者自付部分节省机会为61.982%，实际实现20.256%。
AI.theory_contributions: 为价格透明度工具在医疗决策中的有效性提供了实证证据，深化了对决策支持系统在医疗成本控制中作用的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明了处方药成本决策支持系统在实际应用中的可行性和效果，为医疗系统降低成本和改善患者依从性提供了实用解决方案。

title: The Freedom to Choose: The Effects of Ad Choice Architecture on Video Ad Performance in Online Streaming
affiliations: Donald G. Costello College of Business at George Mason University, Northeastern University and Boston University - Questrom School of Business

detail.title: The Freedom to Choose: The Effects of Ad Choice Architecture on Video Ad Performance in Online Streaming

publicationDetails.detailsText: Donald G. Costello College of Business at George Mason University Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Donald G. Costello College of Business at George Mason University Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Online platforms increasingly rely on advertisements for revenue, yet forced ad exposure can undermine user engagement. Granting users control over ad experiences is a promising solution, but common implementations-such as letting users choose the ad content-can introduce cognitive burdens and platform-level challenges. We propose a novel alternative: ad timing control, which allows users to choose when to view ads. Across three studies, we evaluate this approach. Study 1 shows that users perceive ad timing choice as more meaningful, less effortful, and more preferable than content choice. Study 2 provides causal evidence that ad timing control increases attention, reduces annoyance, and improves brand outcomes. Study 3 benchmarks these effects against the prevalent ad content choice architecture and finds that ad timing choice performs just as well. Together, these results establish ad timing choice as a structurally simpler yet equally effective alternative to content choice. We contribute to the literature on ad choice architecture and autonomy in Information Systems (IS) by theorizing timing control as a viable alternative for video streaming platforms. Ad timing choice offers platforms an autonomy-supportive design that enhances advertising effectiveness while potentially alleviating the operational constraints associated with control over ad content. We provide guidance for practitioners seeking scalable interventions to balance monetization with user experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的广告控制方式——广告时机选择，让用户选择何时观看广告。研究发现，与传统的广告内容选择相比，时机选择被用户认为更有意义、更省力、更受欢迎，能提高注意力、减少烦恼并改善品牌效果，且效果与内容选择相当。
AI.research_question: 广告时机选择是否比广告内容选择更有效？
AI.motivation: 在线平台依赖广告收入，但强制广告曝光会损害用户参与度。给用户广告体验控制权是可行方案，但常见的广告内容选择会带来认知负担和平台层面挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 广告选择架构理论、信息系统中的自主权理论
AI.method: 三个研究：研究1比较用户对广告时机选择和内容选择的感知；研究2提供因果证据；研究3将广告时机选择与流行的广告内容选择架构进行基准比较。
AI.findings: 用户认为广告时机选择比内容选择更有意义、更省力、更受欢迎；广告时机控制能增加注意力、减少烦恼、改善品牌效果；广告时机选择与内容选择效果相当。
AI.theory_contributions: 将时机控制理论化为视频流媒体平台的可行替代方案，为广告选择架构和信息系统自主权文献做出贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台提供可扩展的自主支持设计，在增强广告效果的同时可能缓解与广告内容控制相关的运营约束，为寻求平衡货币化与用户体验的从业者提供指导。

title: From Efficiency to Symbiosis: Rethinking AI as Cognitive Accelerator and Meaning Amplifier
affiliations: Nanyang Technological University (NTU)

detail.title: From Efficiency to Symbiosis: Rethinking AI as Cognitive Accelerator and Meaning Amplifier
detail.abstract: This paper explores the future positioning and responsibility allocation of artificial intelligence in the context of human-machine collaboration. Currently, AI is mostly regarded as an "Efficiency Tool", and its value is mainly reflected in cost reduction and efficiency improvement. However, this positioning will cause employment shocks, social division, and institutional lags in the long run. Through historical comparison, this paper proposes that the inevitable path for the development of artificial intelligence is to transition from an "Efficiency Tool" to a "Creator" and finally evolve into a "Symbiosis Engine". In this process, the dilemma of AI in cultural understanding stems from the lack of contextual positioning and tension judgment. This paper introduces the Field & Shi framework as a necessary condition for AI to develop cultural concepts: Field provides contextual coordinates, Shi provides structural tension, and the final naming and adjudication are still completed by humans. Further, this paper establishes the division of labor and the boundary of human-machine collaboration: humans are the namers, adjudicators, and direction setters; AI is the cognitive accelerator, meaning amplifier, and evidence write-back (knowledge archiving). The upper limit of future AI collaboration is reflected in two types of roles-personal strategic advisor and personal secretarycorresponding to multi-path development and knowledge precipitation respectively. In terms of responsibility, this paper uses the "Sovereign-Minister Analogy" to point out that AI is always a counselor rather than a sovereign, and the responsibility for its mistakes ultimately belongs to humans and organizations. Facing the reality of responsibility dissipation dynamics, the traditional positivist legal system has difficulty coping with the multi-node and networked algorithm risks. This paper proposes that the legal and governance systems should be iterated from the perspective of Philosophy-Engineering, and MemeLex can be a candidate path to provide methodological support for responsibility modeling and institutional update. Generally speaking, the future role of AI is not to replace but to collaborate; not to weaken humans but to amplify human creativity and adjudication ability.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨AI从"效率工具"向"创造者"最终到"共生引擎"的必然发展路径，提出人机协作的职责边界：人类负责命名、裁决和方向设定，AI作为认知加速器和意义放大器，并建立责任分配的"君臣类比"框架。
AI.research_question: 人工智能在人机协作中的未来定位和责任分配是什么？
AI.motivation: 当前AI主要被视为"效率工具"，但这种定位长期会导致就业冲击、社会分化和制度滞后，需要重新思考AI的发展路径和职责边界。
AI.theoretical_framework: Field & Shi框架（Field提供情境坐标，Shi提供结构张力）、人机协作分工理论、君臣类比责任框架、哲学-工程视角的治理迭代。
AI.method: 历史比较分析、理论框架构建、类比推理。
AI.findings: AI发展必然从效率工具→创造者→共生引擎；人机协作边界：人类是命名者、裁决者、方向设定者，AI是认知加速器、意义放大器、证据回写者；AI协作上限是个人战略顾问和个人秘书。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出AI文化理解困境的根源、建立Field & Shi文化概念发展框架、明确人机协作的职责边界、构建君臣类比的责任分配模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI治理提供哲学-工程迭代视角、提出MemeLex作为责任建模和制度更新的方法路径、指导人机协作的实际分工安排。

title: Peer Review: A Tarnished "Gold Standard"
affiliations: Nonpartisan Education Group

detail.title: Peer Review: A Tarnished "Gold Standard"
detail.abstract:
As it is, the traditional peer review system relies on unpaid volunteers from a small population of very busy people to perform an intensive and time-consuming task. Two types of scholars feel most compelled to review papers: Those intrinsically motivated (not necessarily for noble reasons) such as the aforementioned reviewer, and those who “have to,” such as graduate students and not-yet-tenured professors.
The traditional peer review process demands enormous amounts of time while providing only hit-or-miss and superficial appraisals of research quality. The result is a proliferation of scholarship of widely varying quality and much duplication of effort. This regime benefits scholars individually by thickening their curriculum vitae.

AI.tldr: 传统同行评审系统依赖少数忙碌专家的无偿劳动，存在评审质量参差不齐、效率低下、重复劳动等问题，但能帮助学者丰富个人履历。
AI.research_question: 传统同行评审系统存在哪些系统性问题和局限性？
AI.motivation: 当前同行评审系统依赖少数专家的无偿劳动，导致评审质量不稳定、效率低下，且产生了大量质量参差不齐的研究成果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于同行评审制度的社会学分析，涉及激励机制、学术评价体系等理论。
AI.method: 文献分析和批判性论述。
AI.findings: 传统同行评审系统存在时间消耗大、评审质量不稳定、重复劳动等问题，但能帮助学者丰富个人履历。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了同行评审系统的内在矛盾和局限性，为改进评审制度提供理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出了当前学术评价体系的问题，为改革同行评审制度提供实践参考。

title: AMLNet: A Knowledge-Based Multi-Agent Framework to Generate and Detect Realistic Money Laundering Transactions
affiliations: , Griffith University, Griffith University, The University of Newcastle and Griffith University

detail.title: AMLNet: A Knowledge-Based Multi-Agent Framework to Generate and Detect Realistic Money Laundering Transactions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this article.

detail.abstract: Anti-money laundering (AML) research is constrained by the lack of publicly shareable, regulation-aligned transaction datasets. We present AMLNet, a knowledge-based multi-agent framework with two coordinated units: a regulation-aware transaction generator and an ensemble detection pipeline. The generator produces 1,090,173 synthetic transactions (approximately 0.16% laundering-positive) spanning core laundering phases (placement, layering, integration) and advanced typologies (e.g., structuring, adaptive threshold behavior). Regulatory alignment reaches 75% based on AUSTRAC rule coverage (Section 4.2), while a composite technical fidelity score of 0.75 summarizes temporal, structural, and behavioral realism components (Section 4.4). The detection ensemble achieves F1 0.90 (precision 0.84, recall 0.97) on the internal test partitions of AMLNet and adapts to the external SynthAML dataset, indicating architectural generalizability across different synthetic generation paradigms. We provide multidimensional evaluation (regulatory, temporal, network, behavioral) and release the dataset (Version 1.0, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.16736515), to advance reproducible and regulation-conscious AML experimentation.

AI.tldr: AMLNet是一个基于知识的多代理框架，包含监管感知的交易生成器和集成检测管道，生成109万条合成交易数据，解决了反洗钱研究缺乏公开可共享数据集的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个监管对齐、技术保真度高的合成交易数据集，以支持可重复的反洗钱研究？
AI.motivation: 反洗钱研究因缺乏公开可共享且符合监管要求的交易数据集而受到限制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于知识的多代理框架，包含监管对齐和集成检测的理论基础。
AI.method: 采用双单元协调框架：监管感知交易生成器和集成检测管道，生成覆盖洗钱核心阶段和高级类型的合成交易。
AI.findings: 监管对齐度达75%，技术保真度得分0.75；检测集成在内部测试中F1得分0.90，在外部数据集上表现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了监管对齐的合成数据生成框架，为反洗钱研究提供了理论基础和方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 发布了AMLNet数据集（版本1.0），支持多维评估（监管、时间、网络、行为），推动可重复的反洗钱实验研究。

title: Game-Changer or Not? The Role of Generative AI in Digital Game Innovation
affiliations: , Xi'an Jiaotong University, Zhejiang University and New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business

detail.title: Game-Changer or Not? The Role of Generative AI in Digital Game Innovation
detail.abstract: The rapid advancement of generative artificial intelligence (GAI) is transforming the digital game industry. Yet, its impact on game innovation and the mechanisms at work remains underexplored. This study exploits a policy change on Steam, the world’s largest PC game platform, which lifted restrictions on AI-generated content and mandated disclosure of its use. Leveraging this policy change as a shock, we employ a difference-in-differences framework to estimate the causal effect of generative AI adoption on innovation at the game level. Our findings show that GAI adoption increases weekly game updates by 95.66% on average, with effects peaking shortly after adoption and gradually tapering off. Mechanism analysis reveals a more pronounced boost to incremental innovation, while effects on more substantial innovation are limited. Heterogeneity analysis indicates that high-skilled developers realize significantly greater innovation gains than low-skilled developers do, suggesting that GAI acts as a skill amplifier. Finally, GAI-enabled innovation improves product performance, increasing daily active users (review volume) by 27.63% (23.24%). Together, these findings show how GAI reshapes innovation dynamics in the digital game industry, show that benefits accrue unevenly across developer skill levels, and document downstream market outcomes, with implications for theory and practice in creative industries.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用Steam平台政策变化作为自然实验，发现生成式AI的采用使游戏周更新量平均增加95.66%，主要促进渐进式创新，且高技能开发者获益更大，最终提升产品表现。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能对游戏创新的影响机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI快速发展正在改变数字游戏行业，但其对游戏创新的影响机制尚未得到充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创新理论、技能放大理论、技术采纳理论
AI.method: 利用Steam平台政策变化作为外生冲击，采用双重差分法估计生成式AI采用对游戏创新的因果效应
AI.findings: 1) GAI采用使周游戏更新量平均增加95.66%；2) 主要促进渐进式创新；3) 高技能开发者获益更大；4) 创新提升产品表现（日活跃用户增加27.63%，评论量增加23.24%）
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了GAI作为技能放大器的机制，阐明了GAI在创意产业中重塑创新动态的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为游戏开发者提供AI采用策略指导，为平台政策制定提供实证依据，帮助理解AI在创意产业中的差异化影响

title: Institutional Weaknesses in Implementing the Principles of the European Qualifications Framework in the Higher Education System in Kosovo

detail.title: Institutional Weaknesses in Implementing the Principles of the European Qualifications Framework in the Higher Education System in Kosovo
detail.abstract: The European Union envisages and handles the economic integration process through the creation of a unified system of higher education. As part of this aspect, which is vital for the future of this community, the Heads of Governments, supported by the recommendations of the Ministers of Education and Training, a year earlier in March 2005 in Brussels, laid down the requirement for the establishment of a European Qualifications Framework as a basic and separate document, which shall not only be implemented by member countries on a voluntary basis, without conditions and without obligation, but also to increase transparency and mutual trust that will first enable the creation of a clear framework of qualifications, at the national and sectorial level as referent to one another, and secondly, this system will enable the transfer of knowledge and skills for the citizens in the European area. Along with other important documents that are in effect, there is also a current legal basis for the European integration process of this area, and the terms and conditions stipulated therein have been adequately understood by Kosovo. So far, the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology has issued a series of important documents and a solid base for moving forward in this direction has been created. However, the situation is complicated when the time comes for these policies to be implemented in reality. This is because there is still a lack of willingness form the management of Higher Education Providers to enhance quality, improve competence and adapt to the European minimum higher education standards required by the European Qualifications Framework. It is clearly considered as an important step forward to issue policies, but alone it remains insufficient in substance. The responsibility of implementing them lies with everyone, therefore any delay in this regard, not only damages the integration process of the country, but it also depreciates and renders a University degree as unacceptable.

AI.tldr: 欧盟通过建立统一的高等教育体系推动经济一体化进程，但科索沃在实施欧洲资格框架时面临高等教育机构缺乏改进质量和适应欧洲标准的意愿，导致政策实施困难。
AI.research_question: 科索沃在实施欧洲资格框架过程中面临的主要挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: 欧盟通过高等教育一体化推动经济整合，科索沃需要适应这一进程，但实际执行面临困难。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧洲一体化理论、高等教育质量保障理论、政策实施理论
AI.method: 政策文件分析和现状评估
AI.findings: 科索沃已建立政策基础，但高等教育机构缺乏改进质量和适应欧洲标准的意愿，导致政策实施受阻。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了政策制定与实施之间的差距，强调了机构意愿在政策执行中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为科索沃高等教育改革提供实践指导，强调需要加强机构层面的质量改进意愿。

title: GigaView: An End-to-End AI Processing Platform for Smart City Applications
affiliations: Universidade de Brasília (UnB), Universidade de Brasília (UnB), affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Brasilia, University of Brasilia, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Brasilia, Universidade de Brasilia, Universidade Federal do Piauí, Universidade de Brasília (UnB) and Universidade de Brasília (UnB)

detail.title: GigaView: An End-to-End AI Processing Platform for Smart City Applications
detail.abstract: HighlightsNew Artificial Intelligence Native Cloud Computing Platform: GigaView;Based on Mobile Cloud Computing a distributed high performance cloud platform for AI; andTwo successful case-studies using GigaView hosted at GigaCandanga GigaViewAn End-to-End AI Processing Platform for Smart City ApplicationsHigh urban population densities present numerous challenges that can be addressed by smart city technologies, such as the Internet of Things (IoT), integrated with Artificial Intelligence (AI) techniques and computer vision. However, processing large amounts of generated data requires a scalable and efficient AI platform, a need not fully met by existing systems. This paper introduces GigaView, a distributed, general-purpose AI processing platform designed to support scalable computer vision and IoT services for smart city applications. GigaView features a novel end-to-end architecture with three core components—GigaAgent, GigaGateway, and GigaCore—that manage the entire workflow from decentralized data gathering to processing and viewing. The platform is engineered to optimize the use of processing resources, support a wide range of AI models, and implement a quality of service based association for enhanced network performance. We demonstrate the practical contributions and versatility of GigaView through two real-world use cases: GigaSistêmica, an AI pipeline for automated medical screening of osteoporosis and carotid atheroma calcifications on dental radiographs, and SEMFOGO-DF, a solution for real-time fire and smoke detection in the Brazilian Cerrado. GigaView provides a comprehensive and scalable solution that addresses a critical gap in AI processing for responsive urban environments.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了GigaView——一个专为智慧城市应用设计的分布式AI处理平台，具有端到端架构，包含GigaAgent、GigaGateway和GigaCore三个核心组件，支持可扩展的计算机视觉和物联网服务。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个能够有效处理智慧城市应用中大规模数据的分布式AI处理平台？
AI.motivation: 高城市人口密度带来的挑战需要智慧城市技术解决，但现有系统无法完全满足处理大规模数据所需的可扩展和高效AI平台需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于移动云计算和分布式高性能云平台的AI处理框架，结合计算机视觉和物联网技术。
AI.method: 设计并实现了GigaView平台的端到端架构，包含三个核心组件：GigaAgent（数据采集）、GigaGateway（数据传输）、GigaCore（数据处理）。
AI.findings: 通过两个实际案例验证了GigaView的实用性：GigaSistêmica（骨质疏松和颈动脉粥样硬化钙化的自动医学筛查）和SEMFOGO-DF（实时火灾和烟雾检测）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个新颖的端到端AI处理平台架构，优化了处理资源使用，支持多种AI模型，并实现了基于服务质量关联的网络性能增强。
AI.practical_contributions: 为响应式城市环境提供了全面的可扩展AI处理解决方案，填补了现有系统的关键空白，支持智慧城市应用的实施。

title: Do Power-Grid Quality and Natural Resources Moderate Unemployment under Economic Shocks? Evidence from Iran
affiliations: Islamic Azad University (IAU) - Economics and Accounting College and Islamic Azad University (IAU) - Central Tehran Branch

detail.title: Do Power-Grid Quality and Natural Resources Moderate Unemployment under Economic Shocks? Evidence from Iran

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: In resource-dependent economies, the central question is how far resource–energy channels moderate the impact of macroeconomic pressures on unemployment and how this relationship changes under sanctions. Using Iranian annual data for 1991–2024, we estimate an Autoregressive Distributed Lag–Error Correction Model (ARDL–ECM) and, via Principal Components Analysis (PCA), construct two indices: a Power-Grid Quality Index (PRQI; capacity factor, installed nameplate capacity per person, and transmission-and-distribution losses) and a Natural-Resources Index (NRI; agricultural-land share, water-stress index, and natural-resources depletion). Controls include consumer price inflation, the output gap, the real effective exchange rate (REER), and net migration; a sanctions dummy interacts with PRQI and NRI. Cointegration holds, and the error-correction term is negative with a magnitude of about −0.67. On average, sanctions raise unemployment by about 4.73 percentage points, with a 95 percent confidence interval from 1.07 to 8.39. Inflation lowers unemployment in the long run; the output gap reduces it in the short run; REER effects are small and partly offsetting; net migration is insignificant. Under sanctions, moderation is asymmetric: stronger PRQI acts as a shock absorber, whereas higher NRI acts as an amplifier. Scenario analysis corroborates this pattern: at high NRI the sanction effect is around 9.73 percentage points, with a 95 percent confidence interval from 2.83 to 16.63, while at high PRQI and low NRI it is close to zero. Standard cointegration and stability diagnostics support the model’s adequacy and stability. Policy should prioritize near-term grid reliability and, over the medium term, water and natural-resource governance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在资源依赖型经济体中，资源-能源渠道如何调节宏观经济压力对失业的影响，以及这种关系在制裁下的变化。使用伊朗1991-2024年数据，发现制裁平均使失业率上升约4.73个百分点。在制裁下，电网质量指数(PRQI)起缓冲作用，而自然资源指数(NRI)起放大作用。
AI.research_question: 资源-能源渠道如何调节宏观经济压力对失业的影响？这种调节作用在制裁下如何变化？
AI.motivation: 在资源依赖型经济体中，理解资源-能源渠道对失业的调节作用，特别是在制裁等外部冲击下的变化，对政策制定具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资源依赖理论和宏观经济理论，构建了资源-能源渠道对失业影响的调节框架。
AI.method: 使用伊朗1991-2024年年度数据，采用自回归分布滞后-误差修正模型(ARDL-ECM)，通过主成分分析(PCA)构建电网质量指数(PRQI)和自然资源指数(NRI)。
AI.findings: 制裁平均使失业率上升4.73个百分点；通胀在长期降低失业；产出缺口在短期减少失业；在制裁下，PRQI起缓冲作用，NRI起放大作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了资源-能源渠道在制裁下对失业影响的非对称调节机制，拓展了资源依赖理论在外部冲击下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策建议：短期内优先保障电网可靠性，中期加强水资源和自然资源治理。

title: On the Thermodynamic Consequences of Belief in Meta-Cognitive Bayesian Belief Evidence Networks: Manifestation and Experience of Reality Processes in Agents

detail.title: On the Thermodynamic Consequences of Belief in Meta-Cognitive Bayesian Belief Evidence Networks: Manifestation and Experience of Reality Processes in Agents
detail.abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive mechanistic analysis demonstrating the mathematical necessity of divine frameworks across all domains of conscious experience and social organization. Through systematic examination of nine independent analytical pathways-fire-circle consciousness genesis, behavioral transmission systems, computational truth optimization, circle graph governance, evil as logical contradiction, economic information theory, reality navigation algorithms, Genesis coordinate systems, and thermodynamic consciousness thresholds-we establish nine fundamental propositions proving that divine architectural frameworks represent the unique solution to irreducible requirements across consciousness emergence, social coordination, moral consistency, economic function, and reality navigation. Our analysis integrates findings from evolutionary biology, quantum consciousness theory, information theory, game theory, thermodynamics, biblical linguistics, and mathematical proof theory to present the first complete unified framework demonstrating God's existence through pure logical necessity rather than theological argumentation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过九个独立分析路径证明了神圣框架在所有意识体验和社会组织领域的数学必要性，建立了九个基本命题，证明神圣架构框架是意识涌现、社会协调、道德一致性、经济功能和现实导航等不可约要求的唯一解决方案。
AI.research_question: 神圣框架是否在所有意识体验和社会组织领域中具有数学必要性？
AI.motivation: 通过纯逻辑必要性而非神学论证来证明上帝的存在，建立第一个完整的统一框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合进化生物学、量子意识理论、信息理论、博弈论、热力学、圣经语言学和数学证明理论。
AI.method: 系统检查九个独立分析路径：火圈意识生成、行为传输系统、计算真理优化、圆图治理、邪恶作为逻辑矛盾、经济信息理论、现实导航算法、创世纪坐标系统和热力学意识阈值。
AI.findings: 建立了九个基本命题，证明神圣架构框架是意识涌现、社会协调、道德一致性、经济功能和现实导航等不可约要求的唯一解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了第一个完整的统一框架，通过纯逻辑必要性而非神学论证来证明上帝的存在。
AI.practical_contributions: 为意识研究、社会组织和道德哲学提供了基于数学必要性的统一理论框架。

title: Predicting the outcome of severe lower limb trauma using a Bayesian Network
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Coventry University, University of Birmingham, Coventry University and University Hospitals Coventry and Warwickshire

detail.title: Predicting the outcome of severe lower limb trauma using a Bayesian Network

keywords.keywords: Open fracture Lower extremity Machine learning Decision supportLimb reconstruction

detail.abstract: IntroductionThe decision between salvage and amputation of a severely traumatised limb relies upon a detailed understanding of the interaction between a diverse range of variables.  Machine learning techniques can harness data patterns to support decision-making in complex scenarios.  This study aims to develop a model to predict limb salvage at the initial assessment of an open fracture.Materials and MethodsA clinical dataset was populated through a local database search; the primary outcome of interest was limb salvage.  Model input variables were defined through a systematic literature review, an expert opinion panel and a data-driven feature selection algorithm.  A Bayesian network (BN) structure was derived from the dataset and refined by incorporating subject experts’ knowledge.  The predictive performance of the BN was evaluated using cross-validation performance measures and the area under the curve (AUC).  The BN’s predictions were compared to current injury scores.    ResultsThe dataset comprised 374 fractures; the limb salvage rate was 94.4%.  The hybridised selection method identified ten variables for use within the model.  The BN predicted the outcome in 96.7% of cases with an AUC of 0.736.  The BN’s performance was superior to the Mangled Extremity Severity Score (94.8%) and OTA Open Fracture Classification (96%).  ConclusionsThe BN permits the calculation of accurate predictions about outcomes in advance of contemporary systems.  Displaying the model as a network clearly demonstrates the relationships between the influential variables.  This network can support complex treatment decision-making and facilitate discussions with patients about the severity of their injuries.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个贝叶斯网络模型，用于在开放性骨折初次评估时预测肢体挽救结果。该模型通过混合选择方法确定了10个变量，预测准确率达96.7%，AUC为0.736，性能优于现有的损伤评分系统。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个模型来预测开放性骨折初次评估时的肢体挽救结果？
AI.motivation: 严重创伤肢体的挽救与截肢决策依赖于对多种变量相互作用的深入理解，机器学习技术可以利用数据模式支持复杂情景下的决策制定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯网络理论，该理论能够处理不确定性并展示变量间的因果关系。
AI.method: 通过本地数据库搜索构建临床数据集，通过系统文献回顾、专家意见小组和数据驱动的特征选择算法定义模型输入变量，从数据集推导贝叶斯网络结构并融入专家知识进行优化。
AI.findings: 数据集包含374例骨折，肢体挽救率为94.4%。贝叶斯网络预测准确率为96.7%，AUC为0.736，性能优于Mangled Extremity Severity Score（94.8%）和OTA Open Fracture Classification（96%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了一个基于贝叶斯网络的预测模型，能够提前计算准确的结果预测，并清晰展示影响变量间的关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 该模型可以支持复杂的治疗决策制定，并促进与患者关于其损伤严重程度的讨论。

title: Welfare and the Act of Competing

detail.title: Welfare and the Act of Competing
detail.abstract: Economists often view competition as a positive force that incentivizes effort and improves efficiency. Yet a full accounting of the welfare effects of competition requires consideration of the direct utility costs and benefits of competition itself. This paper investigates how competition affects utility derived purely from the act of competing, independent of realized outcomes. I conduct a series of experiments which show that competition shapes utility through two opposing channels: a belief channel, whereby competition lowers expectations of success, thus reducing utility; and an intrinsic utility channel, whereby individuals derive enjoyment directly from competing. The overall effect depends on the relative strength of these channels. I also show that these utility effects can impact future choices: attribution bias in competitive settings, as it leads individuals to misattribute the enjoyment of competition to the underlying task. This effect also reduces post-competition zero-sum thinking and fosters altruism.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验研究发现，竞争通过两个对立渠道影响效用：信念渠道（降低成功预期）和内在效用渠道（从竞争中获得享受）。整体效应取决于这两个渠道的相对强度。竞争还会影响未来选择，导致归因偏差，减少零和思维并促进利他行为。
AI.research_question: 竞争如何影响独立于实际结果的纯粹竞争行为带来的效用？
AI.motivation: 经济学家通常认为竞争是激励努力和提高效率的积极力量，但要全面评估竞争的福利效应，需要考虑竞争本身的直接效用成本和收益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争效用理论，包括信念渠道（降低成功预期）和内在效用渠道（从竞争中获得享受）
AI.method: 进行一系列实验研究
AI.findings: 1. 竞争通过两个对立渠道影响效用：信念渠道降低效用，内在效用渠道增加效用；2. 竞争导致归因偏差，使个体将竞争乐趣错误归因于基础任务；3. 竞争减少零和思维并促进利他行为
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了竞争效用的双渠道理论框架，揭示了竞争对效用的复杂影响机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解竞争环境中的行为决策提供新视角，对组织管理和政策制定具有启示意义

title: Does Physical Exercise Facilitate Labor Participation? Evidence from the Chinese General Social Survey
affiliations: Guangdong University of Finance, Southern Medical University, Guangdong University of Finance and Macao Polytechnic University

detail.title: Does Physical Exercise Facilitate Labor Participation? Evidence from the Chinese General Social Survey
detail.abstract: We examine whether physical exercise affects the likelihood of labor participation among Chinese respondents. We argue that physical exercise promotes labor participation by improving individuals’ physical and psychological health. Using data from the 2012-2021 in China General Social Survey (CGSS), we find that physical exercise significantly increase labor participation through two channels: improving physical and psychological health. Cross-sectional tests show that the promotion in labor participation is greater in (1) non-obese and young groups or (2) those engaged in brainwork and non-state-owned enterprise employees. Our study provides important insights into how to improve labor force participation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现体育锻炼通过改善身心健康显著提高中国受访者的劳动参与率，且对非肥胖群体、年轻人、脑力劳动者和非国企员工的影响更大。
AI.research_question: 体育锻炼是否影响中国受访者的劳动参与可能性？
AI.motivation: 探讨如何通过体育锻炼来提高劳动力参与率，为改善劳动力市场提供重要见解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于健康经济学和劳动经济学理论，认为体育锻炼通过改善身心健康促进劳动参与。
AI.method: 使用2012-2021年中国综合社会调查（CGSS）数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 体育锻炼通过改善身心健康显著提高劳动参与率；对非肥胖群体、年轻人、脑力劳动者和非国企员工的促进作用更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了健康与劳动参与关系的理论机制，明确了体育锻炼通过身心健康双通道影响劳动参与。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府和企业制定促进劳动参与的政策提供了实证依据，建议重视体育锻炼在劳动力市场中的作用。

title: Auction Identification with Unobserved Rejected Offers
affiliations: University of Melbourne, Hebrew University of Jerusalem - Department of Economics and University of Melbourne - Department of Economics

detail.title: Auction Identification with Unobserved Rejected Offers
detail.abstract: We study identification of buyer and seller primitives in second-price auctions when only successful transactions are observed and sellers may reject the highest bid. In our framework a sale occurs only if the top bidder value exceeds a seller-chosen threshold that is unobserved by the econometrician. We first show that point identification using variation in the number of bidders is often achievable but may fail: in the two-point case the model has set-identified data regions in which price distributions can be rationalised by two pairs of value and threshold distributions. For general supports we reduce identification to a fixed point in the ratio of sale probabilities across bidder counts; uniqueness yields point identification. We then show that upper-tail support separation between the buyer value and threshold distributions is a sufficient condition for point identification. A conduct assumption maps thresholds into seller values; absent conduct we derive bounds based on assumptions similar to Haile and Tamer (2003). Monte Carlo experiments validate the approach and quantify biases from ignoring rejected offers.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了在仅能观察到成功交易且卖家可能拒绝最高出价的第二价格拍卖中，买方和卖方基本特征的识别问题。作者证明在某些条件下可以实现点识别，但也存在识别失败的情况，并提出了确保点识别的充分条件。
AI.research_question: 在仅能观察到成功交易且卖家可能拒绝最高出价的第二价格拍卖中，如何识别买方和卖方的基本特征？
AI.motivation: 传统拍卖模型通常假设所有最高出价都会被接受，但现实中卖家可能拒绝最高出价，这给识别买方价值分布和卖方阈值带来了挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 第二价格拍卖理论、部分识别理论、固定点理论
AI.method: 理论分析、固定点方法、蒙特卡洛实验
AI.findings: 1) 点识别在投标人数量变化时通常可实现但可能失败；2) 在两点情况下存在集合识别的数据区域；3) 买方价值和卖方阈值分布的上尾支撑分离是点识别的充分条件
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了在卖家可能拒绝最高出价情况下的识别框架；2) 提出了基于固定点理论的识别方法；3) 推导了点识别的充分条件
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了处理拍卖数据中未观测到拒绝出价的方法；2) 量化了忽略拒绝出价带来的偏差；3) 为实证拍卖研究提供了新的识别策略

title: AIGN Systemic AI Governance Stress Test
affiliations: AIGN – Artificial Intelligence Governance Network

detail.title: AIGN Systemic AI Governance Stress Test

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants or sensitive personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It is part of the independent AIGN OS Research Series.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Part of the AIGN OS Research Series (Working Paper)

detail.abstract:
Artificial Intelligence (AI) is increasingly deployed in high-risk domains such as healthcare, finance, energy, education, and public administration. While global frameworks—including the EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF, OECD AI Principles, and UNESCO guidance—define obligations and ethical baselines, governance practice remains static: dominated by documentation, self-assessments, and audits. These tools capture preparedness but not resilience.

This paper introduces the AIGN Systemic Governance Stress Test, the first methodology designed to evaluate the resilience of AI governance structures under simulated regulatory, ethical, and operational crises. Inspired by Basel III financial stress tests and TCFD climate risk scenarios, the framework applies six weighted phases—Foundation & Scoping, Regulatory Shock, Ethical & Crisis Simulation, Systemic Dependency, Organizational Stress & Culture, and Scoring & Roadmap—each mapped to binding regulations, international standards, and governance theory.

The Stress Test produces a Governance Resilience Score (AAA–C), accompanied by scenario-specific insights and transformation roadmaps. By bridging fragmented frameworks into a unified resilience benchmark, it establishes a new evaluative category for AI governance.

Academically, the paper contributes by anchoring governance resilience in systems theory, trust repair, and organizational adaptation. Practically, it provides regulators, boards, and investors with a measurable benchmark for systemic AI governance maturity. It also lays the foundation for the envisioned Governance Twin—a digital twin of governance systems—marking a paradigm shift in AI governance from static obligation to a living infrastructure of trust.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AIGN系统性治理压力测试方法，这是首个评估AI治理结构在模拟监管、伦理和运营危机下韧性的方法论。该方法借鉴金融和气候风险压力测试，通过六个加权阶段评估治理韧性，生成治理韧性评分和转型路线图。
AI.research_question: 如何评估AI治理结构在监管、伦理和运营危机下的韧性？
AI.motivation: 当前AI治理实践主要依赖文档、自我评估和审计，这些工具只能捕捉准备状态而非韧性。随着AI在高风险领域的部署，需要能够评估治理系统在危机中持续运作的能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统理论、信任修复理论、组织适应理论，借鉴巴塞尔III金融压力测试和TCFD气候风险场景框架
AI.method: AIGN系统性治理压力测试方法，包含六个加权阶段：基础与范围界定、监管冲击、伦理与危机模拟、系统依赖性、组织压力与文化、评分与路线图
AI.findings: 压力测试生成治理韧性评分（AAA-C），提供场景特定洞察和转型路线图，将碎片化框架统一为韧性基准
AI.theory_contributions: 将治理韧性锚定在系统理论、信任修复和组织适应理论中，为AI治理建立新的评估类别
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构、董事会和投资者提供可衡量的系统性AI治理成熟度基准，为治理孪生（Governance Twin）奠定基础

title: ChatGPT-5 and Grok-4: A Comparative Analysis of Advancements in NLP
affiliations: Cochin University of Science and Technology (CUSAT) - School of Management Studies and Cochin University of Science and Technology (CUSAT)

detail.title: ChatGPT-5 and Grok-4: A Comparative Analysis of Advancements in NLP
detail.abstract: The emergence of ChatGPT-5 and Grok-4 in 2025 highlights two divergent approaches to large language model design. ChatGPT-5 advances OpenAI's tradition of long-context reasoning, multimodal integration, and structured reliability, whereas Grok-4 from xAI emphasizes real-time responsiveness, coding efficiency, and personality-driven interaction. This paper conducts a structured comparison across benchmarks, context capacity, latency, multimodal features, user experience, and ethical considerations. Findings indicate that ChatGPT-5 is better suited for research, education, and professional domains, while Grok-4 excels in live social contexts, rapid coding, and trend analysis. The study underscores that their strengths are complementary rather than substitutive, reflecting broader trade-offs between accuracy and immediacy in next-generation AI systems.

AI.tldr: ChatGPT-5和Grok-4代表了2025年大语言模型的两种不同设计路径：ChatGPT-5专注于长上下文推理、多模态集成和结构化可靠性，适用于研究、教育和专业领域；Grok-4强调实时响应、编码效率和个性化交互，擅长社交场景、快速编码和趋势分析。研究发现两者优势互补而非替代。
AI.research_question: ChatGPT-5和Grok-4在大语言模型设计方法上存在哪些关键差异？这些差异如何影响它们在不同应用场景中的表现？
AI.motivation: 随着ChatGPT-5和Grok-4在2025年同时发布，理解这两种不同设计哲学的大语言模型在性能、适用场景和用户体验方面的差异，对于指导用户选择和未来模型发展具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于大语言模型设计理论，包括上下文处理能力、多模态集成、响应延迟、用户体验设计等维度构建分析框架。
AI.method: 采用结构化比较方法，在基准测试、上下文容量、延迟、多模态特性、用户体验和伦理考量等多个维度进行系统对比分析。
AI.findings: ChatGPT-5在研究、教育和专业领域表现更优，而Grok-4在实时社交、快速编码和趋势分析方面更具优势。两者的优势是互补的，反映了下一代AI系统在准确性和即时性之间的权衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了大语言模型设计路径的分类框架，揭示了准确性与即时性之间的根本权衡关系，为理解不同设计哲学的价值提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不同应用场景下的模型选择提供了明确指导，帮助用户根据具体需求选择合适的AI工具，同时为模型开发者提供了设计优化的参考方向。

reference: Annual Survey of Indian Law Volume 58 (2022)
title: Banking Law
affiliations: Faculty of Law SRM University Delhi-NCR Sonepat

detail.title: Banking Law

publicationDetails.detailsText: Annual Survey of Indian Law Volume 58 (2022)

detail.abstract: Banking law has evolved into a significant branch of legal practice, gaining increased recognition in recent years, particularly following the enactment of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC) in 2016. Jurisprudence in this domain broadly spans central banking regulation, non-performing assets (NPAs) and their recovery, recovery law supremacy, banking frauds, cheque dishonour cases, consumer protection, regulation of NBFCs and cooperatives, and international banking. Developments in 2022 indicate a decline in NPAs, with IBC emerging as the most effective recovery mechanism compared to other statutory channels. Policy reforms by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and the government, guided by the “4R” framework—Recognition, Resolution, Recapitalisation, and Reforms—have strengthened the sector’s resilience and improved balance sheets. At the same time, the rapid growth of fintech, digital assets, and evolving technologies presents new challenges relating to cybersecurity, digital currency, ESG compliance, and the regulation of non-banking entities. India’s fintech sector, marked by the world’s highest adoption rate, is reshaping the landscape of financial services. Initiatives such as the RBI’s creation of a fintech department, pilot projects on Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC), and digitisation of lending reflect a strong policy thrust toward innovation and a cashless economy. While regulatory stability persists in traditional banking functions, the integration of technology demands continuous legal and institutional adaptation.

AI.tldr: 印度银行业法律在2016年《破产与破产法》颁布后重要性提升，2022年不良资产下降，IBC成为最有效的回收机制。金融科技、数字资产快速发展带来网络安全、数字货币等新挑战，印度金融科技采用率全球最高，正重塑金融服务格局。
AI.research_question: 印度银行业法律如何应对传统银行业务与金融科技融合带来的新挑战？
AI.motivation: 银行业法律已成为重要法律分支，特别是在IBC颁布后。金融科技和数字资产的快速发展带来了网络安全、数字货币、ESG合规等新挑战，需要法律和制度持续适应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于印度储备银行和政府的"4R"框架（识别、解决、资本重组、改革），以及传统银行业监管与金融科技创新的平衡理论。
AI.method: 分析银行业法律发展历程、政策改革效果、金融科技发展趋势，以及相关法规和案例研究。
AI.findings: IBC成为最有效的资产回收机制；不良资产呈下降趋势；金融科技采用率全球最高；RBI设立金融科技部门、开展CBDC试点项目；数字借贷正在重塑金融服务格局。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了传统银行业监管与金融科技创新融合的理论框架，强调了法律和制度持续适应的必要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行业监管机构提供政策建议，帮助金融机构应对金融科技挑战，促进金融服务创新和数字化转型。

title: Calming the Panic: Investor Risk Perceptions and the Fed’s Emergency Lending during the 2023 Bank Run
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York,  and Federal Reserve Bank New York

detail.title: Calming the Panic: Investor Risk Perceptions and the Fed’s Emergency Lending during the 2023 Bank Run

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In a companion post, we showed that during the bank run of spring 2023 investors were seemingly not concerned about bank risk broadly but rather became sensitized to the risk of only about a third of all publicly traded banks. In this post, we investigate how the Federal Reserve’s liquidity support affected investor risk perceptions during the run. We find that the announcement of the Fed’s novel Bank Term Funding Program (BTFP), and subsequent borrowings from the program, substantially reduced investor risk perceptions. However, borrowings from the Fed’s traditional discount window (DW) had no such effect.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在2023年银行挤兑期间，美联储的流动性支持对投资者风险感知产生不同影响：新型银行定期融资计划(BTFP)显著降低了投资者风险感知，而传统贴现窗口(DW)则无此效果。
AI.research_question: 美联储的流动性支持如何影响2023年银行挤兑期间的投资者风险感知？
AI.motivation: 理解不同流动性支持工具对投资者风险感知的差异化影响，为未来危机管理提供政策启示
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资者风险感知理论、流动性支持有效性理论、银行挤兑理论
AI.method: 实证分析，比较BTFP和DW两种流动性支持工具对投资者风险感知的影响
AI.findings: BTFP的宣布和后续借款显著降低了投资者风险感知，而传统DW借款没有类似效果
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了不同流动性支持工具在危机期间对投资者心理的差异化影响机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行在危机期间选择流动性支持工具提供了实证依据，建议优先使用BTFP等新型工具

title: Signals in the Noise: The Asymmetric Validation of Dividends and Share Repurchases
affiliations: University of Münster - Finance Center Münster

detail.title: Signals in the Noise: The Asymmetric Validation of Dividends and Share Repurchases
detail.abstract: While corporate payout policy is well-studied in North America, its valuation effects across diverse global markets remain a persistent enigma. This study resolves this puzzle by proposing and testing a Theory of Context-Dependent Signal Dominance and Asymmetric Validation. The theory posits that payout valuation is determined by the dominance of two competing signals, a negative capital allocation signal and a positive shareholder commitment signal, and that the validation mechanisms for dividends and repurchases are fundamentally asymmetric. Testing this theory on a comprehensive global panel from 1992 to 2024, I find a duality in the dividend signal. From an enterprise value perspective, institutional quality acts as an information substitute, leading to a dividend discount in transparent markets. Conversely, from a shareholder perspective, it acts as a commitment validator, unlocking a premium only when investor protection is strong. In contrast, share repurchases are validated intrinsically by their financial scale while the premium for their scale is highest in less transparent markets, consistent with an information substitution effect, though their valuation is fundamentally anchored in the trust established by a country's deep-rooted legal origin. Channel tests confirm this asymmetry. An institutionally-validated dividend credibly predicts future earnings, while a largescale repurchase primarily mitigates present agency costs without signaling future performance. These findings reveal that dividend signals are context-dependent, their ability to cut through noise is dependent on the interplay of institutional forces, while repurchase signals rely on the "brute force" of their own scale, with their reception shaped by the deep grammar of legal traditions.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了情境依赖信号主导与不对称验证理论，发现在全球市场中，股息和回购的估值效应存在根本性不对称。股息估值取决于制度质量，在透明市场中产生折价，在强投资者保护下产生溢价；回购估值则依赖于财务规模，在透明度低的市场中溢价最高，且根本上受法律传统影响。
AI.research_question: 全球市场中公司分红政策的估值效应如何？股息和回购的信号机制是否存在根本性不对称？
AI.motivation: 虽然北美市场的公司分红政策已有充分研究，但其在全球多样化市场中的估值效应仍是一个未解之谜
AI.theoretical_framework: 情境依赖信号主导与不对称验证理论：分红估值由两个竞争信号（负面资本配置信号和正面股东承诺信号）的主导地位决定，股息和回购的验证机制存在根本性不对称
AI.method: 对1992-2024年全球综合面板数据进行实证检验
AI.findings: 1. 股息信号存在双重性：从企业价值角度看，制度质量作为信息替代品，在透明市场中导致股息折价；从股东角度看，制度质量作为承诺验证者，在强投资者保护下解锁溢价。2. 股票回购通过财务规模内在验证，其规模溢价在透明度低的市场中最高，但估值根本上由国家的深层法律传统建立的信任锚定。3. 渠道测试证实了这种不对称性：制度验证的股息可信预测未来收益，而大规模回购主要缓解当前代理成本而不信号未来表现。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了情境依赖信号主导与不对称验证理论，揭示了股息和回购信号机制的根本性差异，丰富了公司分红政策理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球投资者和公司管理者提供了关于不同市场环境下分红政策估值效应的实用指导，帮助制定更有效的分红策略

title: An Analysis of the Indian Economy During the Three Covid-19 Pandemic Waves
affiliations: Woosong University, Mahindra University and Jagannath International Management School

detail.title: An Analysis of the Indian Economy During the Three Covid-19 Pandemic Waves
detail.abstract: The objective of the study was to examine the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic on India's economy. The analysis focused on several economic metrics, including stock market prices, the rupee's value in relation to the US dollar, economic activity, the unemployment rate, and the rate of inflation. Contrary to popular belief, the results demonstrate that during the first wave (25 March 2020 to 16 September 2020), the increasing number of cases had a beneficial influence on economic activity and a negative impact on the unemployment rate. The second wave, which lasted from 15 March 2021 to 17 July 2021, was considerably stronger and demonstrated how confirmed instances had a significant detrimental impact on inflation rates and stock values. Contrary to expectations, the third wave (December 28, 2021, to January 30, 2022) was found to be less intense. Overall, the report shows how the pandemic affected India's economy during each of the three waves and notes that there have been encouraging signs of recovery during the return to normalcy phase. The government, scholars, policymakers, and economists will find this study useful in understanding how the COVID-19 Pandemic affected the Indian economy and in coming up with ideas for future risk mitigation measures.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了COVID-19大流行对印度经济的影响，发现三波疫情对经济指标的影响各不相同：第一波疫情意外地促进了经济活动并降低了失业率；第二波疫情对股市和通胀率产生了显著负面影响；第三波疫情强度较弱。
AI.research_question: COVID-19大流行对印度经济的具体影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解疫情对印度经济不同方面的影响，为政府、学者和政策制定者提供应对未来风险的参考依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于宏观经济指标分析框架，包括股市价格、汇率、经济活动、失业率和通胀率等关键经济变量。
AI.method: 通过分析三个不同疫情阶段（第一波：2020年3月25日-9月16日；第二波：2021年3月15日-7月17日；第三波：2021年12月28日-2022年1月30日）的经济数据进行比较研究。
AI.findings: 第一波疫情意外地促进了经济活动并降低了失业率；第二波疫情对股市和通胀率产生了显著负面影响；第三波疫情强度较弱，经济在恢复正常阶段显示出积极复苏迹象。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了疫情对经济影响的非线性特征，挑战了传统认知，表明疫情冲击在不同阶段可能产生不同的经济效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度政府、政策制定者和经济学家提供了疫情应对策略的实证依据，有助于制定未来风险缓解措施。

title: Real Strategy as a Foundation Document to Guarantee Quality Management and Assurance in the "Haxhi Zeka" University

detail.title: Real Strategy as a Foundation Document to Guarantee Quality Management and Assurance in the "Haxhi Zeka" University
detail.abstract: Currently, the institutions of the government of the Republic of Kosovo have taken concrete actions to decentralize the Higher Education by opening new universities in the regional centers and by setting the conditions for a competitive intercollegiate environment where the true principles and a condition for a contemporary institution will, above all, be the academic quality management assurance. For this vision, the relevant institutions have issued a series of strategic and legal documents which will provide for an acceptable legal and academic base for all higher education providers and with the proper view of the situation and current needs, they will be drafting and implementing strategic documents. Initially, these documents will guarantee the mechanisms for providing necessary information on all weaknesses, risks, opportunities and priorities of the segments for the university academic development, analyzing these up to the adoption of managerial actions which will ultimately result in a strategic document that guarantees quality and quality only. Although established two years earlier, 'Haxhi Zeka' University has made progress in organizing academic activities but has not yet taken any serious and substantive steps to mobilize all segments within the university and on the basis of shared responsibilities to draft and implement the document with normative and academic force to assure the management of the university's quality. It is considered that the academic quality is related to the well composition of the variables of competencies in teaching and students learning, intercollegiate cooperation, scientific research and adopting programs according to the market requirements and conditions both inside and outside the country. These objectives may be achieved only by specialized managers who are prepared for changes, respectively with a modern manager profile.

AI.tldr: 科索沃政府通过建立新大学和促进高校竞争来推动高等教育分权化，强调学术质量管理的重要性。"Haxhi Zeka"大学虽已成立两年，但在制定和实施质量管理文件方面进展有限。
AI.research_question: 科索沃高等教育分权化背景下，如何通过学术质量管理确保大学教育质量？
AI.motivation: 科索沃政府推动高等教育分权化，需要建立有效的学术质量管理体系来确保教育质量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 学术质量管理理论、高等教育分权化理论、现代管理理论
AI.method: 文献分析、政策文件分析、案例研究（以'Haxhi Zeka'大学为例）
AI.findings: 科索沃政府已制定战略和法律文件支持高等教育分权化，但具体实施进展不一，'Haxhi Zeka'大学在质量管理文件制定方面进展有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了高等教育分权化与学术质量管理相结合的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为科索沃及其他类似背景国家的高等教育机构提供了学术质量管理的实践指导。

reference: Financial and Economic Review, Vol. 24 Issue 3, September 2025, 52–72.
title: Inflation and Inflation Uncertainty: Evidence From GARCH-MIDAS-in-Mean Modelling
affiliations: Central Bank of Hungary, Quoniam Asset Management GmbH and Eötvös Loránd University

detail.title: Inflation and Inflation Uncertainty: Evidence From GARCH-MIDAS-in-Mean Modelling

declarations.declarationOfInterest: nothing to declare

publicationDetails.detailsText: Financial and Economic Review, Vol. 24 Issue 3, September 2025, 52–72.

detail.abstract: We revisit the relationship between inflation and inflation uncertainty using a novel GARCH-MIDAS-in-Mean approach, which allows for the decomposition of inflation uncertainty into short-term and time-varying long-term components. We test our model on UK data. Our findings indicate that macroeconomic and financial variables significantly influence the long-term component of inflation uncertainty. By enabling long-term uncertainty to vary over time through MIDAS filtering, we show that the evidence for past inflation raising short-run uncertainty weakens compared to results that assume a constant long-term inflation uncertainty component. However, our results support the Cukierman–Meltzer hypothesis, indicating that the impact of inflation uncertainty on inflation becomes more robust and pronounced when longer samples are used, although this effect is sensitive to structural breaks, such as the VAT cut and the Covid-19 pandemic. Additionally, we find no evidence that changes in inflation feed back into short-run uncertainty.

detail.abstract: Fishing is one of the major income sources for the people who live along the sea’s shore, and in some areas, fishing is the only income source as well. The purpose of the present study was to evaluate the socioeconomic status and its fluctuations among fishers in the coastal area of Vizianagaram district, Andhra Pradesh. During field surveys, we randomly interviewed the fishermen and their families with the well-prepared questionnaire. We visited 08 villages, and 850 fishermen's families participated in the interview. All of them are Hindu; very few are Christians. Mostly middle-aged fishermen (36–50 years old) are involved in fishing activities. Almost 84% of all families have only one earner, either a father or a son. The majority of the fishermen and their family members were found illiterate (74%). Due to economic problems, 54% of teenagers drop out after high school every year for the sake of their families. Almost 87% of the population is unaware of higher education. Girls from fishing families are studying only up to the tenth grade (80%); a few are studying intermediate (49%); and very few are studying graduation (24%). The monthly income of these fishing families (75–85%) is > Rs. 15,000/- (18.7 USD; 1 USD = Rs. 82). In these villages, 57% of people live in kutcha houses. They spent Rs. 250–350 for their daily expenditures. Almost 48% of families do not have a bore and depend on municipal water for drinking. Around 71% of families do not have bathrooms, and 85% do not have access to a latrine. More than 41% of people drink alcohol on a regular basis, and 34% chew tobacco. So many of these villages' streets lack a proper drainage system. Every year, in the months of June to September, the entire family migrates to Mangamaripeta (Bheemili) and Visakhapatnam for fishing. To further the education of fishermen's children, opportunities should be provided and encouraged financially. Appropriate support should be provided to fishermen by creating awareness about alternative employment opportunities. These villagers are economically poor, have a high percentage of illiteracy, and face unhygienic conditions. Necessary steps should be taken by the government's organizations, NGOs, and respective stakeholders to improve the literacy level as well as livelihood status.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了印度安得拉邦Vizianagaram地区渔民的社会经济状况，发现该群体面临高文盲率、低收入、恶劣生活条件和教育机会有限等严重问题。
AI.research_question: Vizianagaram地区沿海渔民的社会经济状况及其波动情况如何？
AI.motivation: 捕鱼是沿海居民的主要收入来源，在某些地区甚至是唯一收入来源，了解渔民的社会经济状况对改善其生活条件至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会发展理论和贫困循环理论，分析渔民群体的社会经济特征及其影响因素。
AI.method: 通过实地调查，使用准备好的问卷对850个渔民家庭进行随机访谈，覆盖8个村庄。
AI.findings: 84%家庭仅有一个收入来源；74%渔民及其家庭成员为文盲；54%青少年因经济问题高中辍学；87%人口不了解高等教育；75-85%家庭月收入低于15000卢比（18.7美元）；57%居住简陋房屋；48%无自用井水；71%无浴室；85%无厕所；41%经常饮酒；34%嚼烟草。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了沿海渔民群体的多维贫困特征，为理解发展中国家渔民的社会经济困境提供了实证依据。

title: Foreign Demand for Safety and Macroeconomic Instability

detail.abstract: Using novel data on sectoral safe asset positions in 21 advanced economies since 1980, we document the central role of the foreign sector in the market for safety and its macroeconomic implications. We show that safe asset holdings have expanded significantly relative to GDP, driven by rising net holdings of the foreign sector and accommodated by increased issuance from the financial and public sectors. Furthermore, fluctuations in safe assets are almost exclusively driven by the foreign and financial sectors, with close links between the two. Finally, increases in foreign demand for safety-or its counterpart, the supply by financials-are associated with domestic credit expansions and weaker medium-term output growth, both in raw data and when using FX reserve accumulation in Asian economies as instrument.

AI.tldr: 本文使用21个发达经济体1980年以来的部门安全资产数据，发现外国部门在安全资产市场中扮演核心角色。安全资产持有量相对于GDP显著增长，主要由外国部门净持有增加驱动，金融和公共部门发行增加。安全资产波动主要由外国和金融部门驱动，两者密切相关。外国安全需求增加与国内信贷扩张和中期产出增长疲弱相关。

detail.title: Grouping by Achievement: The Importance of Ordinal Rank and Tutorsʼ Instructional Practices Evidence from a Large Norwegian Field Experiment

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We use data from a Norwegian field experiment where young students were taught mathematics in small, homogenous groups to investigate how treatment effects varied across middle-achieving students dependent on their rank order and their tutors’ instructional practices. We find that individuals from the second and fourth quintiles in the pretest score distribution who were placed in groups with lower (higher) ranked students experienced substantially lower (higher) treatment effects than students who were placed in groups with students from the same quintile as themselves. These effects were somewhat modified by the tutors’ instructional practices. Students in the third quintile were unaffected by their within-group rank.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过挪威实地实验发现，在数学小班教学中，中等成绩学生的排名位置和导师教学实践会影响干预效果。第二和第四五分位数的学生在与较低排名学生同组时效果较差，与较高排名学生同组时效果较好，而第三五分位数学生不受组内排名影响。
AI.research_question: 中等成绩学生在同质小班数学教学中，其组内排名位置和导师教学实践如何影响干预效果？

title: Deception Aversion
affiliations: Paris School of Economics (PSE), Paris School of Economics and Texas A&M University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Deception Aversion

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Conveying private information to interested parties is central to almost every economic and social activity. In such interactions, the sender may lie by misreporting the truth, but may also deceive by inducing inaccurate beliefs about the payoff-relevant state. While a huge experimental literature documents aversion to lying, there is little evidence regarding aversion to deceiving others. Deception aversion is conceptually difficult to document because it depends on unobserved second-order beliefs: the sender’s belief over the receiver’s belief (over the payoff-relevant state). In this paper, we introduce a novel game and show theoretically how to identify deception aversion from choice data alone, with minimal assumptions on second-order beliefs. We run a laboratory experiment and find strong support for deception aversion that is robust to several natural variations of the game. Many subjects lie in order to avoid deception, and structural estimates imply that 30% of subjects are deception-averse

detail.abstract: New technologies have made available a vast amount of new data in the form of text, recording an exponentially increasing share of human and corporate behavior. For financial supervisors, the information encoded in text is a valuable complement to the more traditional balance sheet data typically used to track the soundness of financial institutions. In this study, we exploit several natural language processing (NLP) techniques as well as network analysis to detect anomalies in the Spanish corporate system, identifying both idiosyncratic and systemic risks. We use sentiment analysis at the corporate level to detect sentiment anomalies for specific corporations (idiosyncratic risks), while employing a wide range of network metrics to monitor systemic risks. In the realm of supervisory technology (SupTech), anomaly detection in sentiment analysis serves as a proactive tool for financial authorities. By continuously monitoring sentiment trends, SupTech applications can provide early warnings of potential financial distress or systemic risks.

title: Behavioural spillover in the valuation of low-carbon lifestyles: evidence from a choice modelling study
affiliations: Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), University of Leeds and Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)

detail.title: Behavioural spillover in the valuation of low-carbon lifestyles: evidence from a choice modelling study
detail.abstract: Existing approaches to the detection and analysis of behavioural spillover, i.e. when engagement in one type of behaviour influences subsequent actions, are limited in behavioural scope or their ability to infer causal effects. This paper provides new empirical evidence of spillover effects by embedding prior choices directly into the utility function as lagged variables, representing a methodological innovation in spillover research. Our analysis focuses on the willingness to adopt more environmentally friendly behaviours, looking at three lifestyle actions previously identified as the highest impact ones, namely reducing car use, adopting a vegan diet, and transitioning to a vegetarian diet. We find that decisions in an initial hypothetical donation task influence both willingness to adopt further lifestyle changes and valuation of CO2 reductions. Spillover effects are heterogeneous: donations increase the value placed on CO2 reductions (positive spillover) but also the perceived disutility of effortful behaviours (negative spillover). Effects vary across socio-demographics, with women valuing reductions more and younger respondents more reluctant to change. Over time, negative spillover attenuates, while positive spillover remains. These effects also show some variation across behaviour types and survey stages, highlighting the context-specific nature of spillovers. Our discrete choice approach accounts for prior behaviour, controlling for order and learning effects, thereby enhancing internal validity in the the findings isolating the effects of behavioural spillover. The findings are policy-relevant, illustrating how interventions can be designed to leverage engagement and support sustained low-carbon transitions.
