title: Identity and Institutional Change: Evidence from First Names in Germany, 1700–1850
affiliations: Harvard University, University of Bonn and Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich (LMU) - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: Identity and Institutional Change: Evidence from First Names in Germany, 1700–1850

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: How does culture respond to institutional change? We study the collapse of the Holy Roman Empire (1789–1815), when half of Central Europe changed rulers. Using 44 million birth records from hundreds of cities between 1700 and 1850, we measure cultural traits in real time. Cities that experienced ruler change saw greater naming turnover, dispersion, and novelty. We construct control groups using diplomatic records to isolate these effects, which emerged immediately and persisted. The collapse of hegemonic authority weakened state-aligned identities while strengthening religiosity and nationalism. These shifts undermined subsequent state building, highlighting challenges of ideological integration after regime change.

AI.tldr: 神圣罗马帝国解体期间，统治者更迭导致文化特征发生显著变化，表现为命名模式的高度流动性和创新性，同时削弱了国家认同，强化了宗教性和民族主义。
AI.research_question: 制度变迁如何影响文化？以神圣罗马帝国解体（1789-1815）为例，研究统治者更迭对文化特征的影响。
AI.motivation: 探讨制度变迁对文化的动态影响，特别是当半个中欧经历统治者更迭时，文化如何响应这种政治结构的根本性变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度变迁理论、文化演化理论、国家认同与民族主义理论。
AI.method: 使用1700-1850年间数百个城市的4400万条出生记录，实时测量文化特征；利用外交记录构建控制组进行因果识别。
AI.findings: 经历统治者更迭的城市显示出更高的命名流动性、分散性和创新性；这些效应立即出现并持续存在；霸权权威的崩溃削弱了国家认同，同时强化了宗教性和民族主义。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了制度变迁对文化的即时和持久影响机制；证明了政治权威解体如何重塑集体认同。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解政权更迭后的意识形态整合挑战提供了实证依据；对后冲突时期的国家建设具有政策启示。

title: Crowd-Sourced Chinese Genealogies as a Tool for Historical Demography
affiliations: London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE)

detail.title: Crowd-Sourced Chinese Genealogies as a Tool for Historical Demography
detail.abstract: This paper introduces a structured approach for using genealogical records from FamilySearch to study Chinese historical demography. As a proof of concept, we focus on over 190,000 digitized records from a single surname, drawn from many provinces and spanning multiple centuries. These lineage-based microdata include individual-level birth, death, and kinship information, which we clean, validate, and geocode using consistent rules and standardized place names. We begin by documenting descriptive patterns in population growth, sex ratios, and migration. Migration was overwhelmingly local, with longdistance moves rare and concentrated in a small number of lineages. Outmigration rose to a high point between 1750 and 1850 and then declined in later cohorts and generations. We then use the genealogical data to test specific hypotheses. Male-biased sex ratios—likely influenced by female infanticide—are strongly associated with higher rates of male childlessness. Migration rates fall sharply with patrilineal generational depth, offering micro-level evidence that clans became more sedentary over time. Together, these findings show how genealogical records can be used to reconstruct long-run demographic patterns and to assess social processes such as kinship, mobility, and reproductive exclusion. The approach is replicable and extensible to other surnames and regions as data coverage improves.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种使用FamilySearch家谱记录研究中国历史人口学的结构化方法，通过对19万+单一姓氏记录的分析，揭示了人口增长、性别比例、迁移等长期人口模式，并验证了关于男性偏好的性别比例与男性无子女率、宗族世代深度与迁移率的关系假设。
AI.research_question: 如何使用家谱记录研究中国历史人口学？家谱数据能揭示哪些长期人口模式和社会过程？
AI.motivation: 利用家谱记录这一丰富但未被充分开发的数据源，系统研究中国历史人口学，填补传统人口研究方法的空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史人口学、家族谱系学、人口迁移理论、性别比例理论
AI.method: 对19万+单一姓氏家谱记录进行数据清洗、验证和地理编码，采用描述性统计和假设检验方法
AI.findings: 1）迁移主要是本地化，长距离迁移罕见且集中在少数宗族；2）1750-1850年间外迁达到高峰后下降；3）男性偏好的性别比例与男性无子女率高度相关；4）迁移率随父系世代深度显著下降
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了使用家谱记录研究历史人口学的系统方法框架，提供了宗族随时间变得更加定居的微观证据
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可复制、可扩展的研究方法，可应用于其他姓氏和地区，为历史人口研究提供了新工具

title: Endogenous Discounting and Economic Dynamics
affiliations: European University at St. Petersburg (EUSP), University of Paris-Saclay, University Paris-Saclay, National Economics University, Hanoi, Vietna and University of the Balearic Islands

detail.title: Endogenous Discounting and Economic Dynamics

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study a discrete-time optimal growth model with endogenous discounting. The discount factor may depend on both consumption and the capital stock, and intertemporal utility is modeled as a discounted sum of instantaneous utilities, with the sum of discount factors equal to one. We show that this specification preserves the invariance of optimal paths and steady states to affine transformations of the instantaneous utility function, providing a general and flexible framework for analyzing economic dynamics under endogenous time preference. We prove that optimal capital paths are monotonic, and steady states depend on initial conditions. We also show the robustness of poverty traps under endogenous discounting: in several examples, for a set of parameters with positive measure, the optimal path converges to a positive steady state only if the initial capital stock exceeds a critical level and otherwise converges to the origin.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个具有内生贴现的离散时间最优增长模型，证明了最优资本路径的单调性和稳态对初始条件的依赖性，并展示了内生贴现下贫困陷阱的稳健性。
AI.research_question: 内生贴现如何影响最优增长模型中的经济动态和贫困陷阱？
AI.motivation: 研究内生时间偏好在经济增长模型中的作用，特别是其对最优路径和稳态的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 离散时间最优增长模型，内生贴现因子取决于消费和资本存量，跨期效用为瞬时效用的贴现和。
AI.method: 理论分析和数学证明，通过构建内生贴现模型并推导最优路径性质。
AI.findings: 最优资本路径具有单调性，稳态依赖于初始条件；内生贴现下贫困陷阱具有稳健性，只有当初始资本超过临界水平时才会收敛到正稳态。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个保留瞬时效用函数仿射变换不变性的内生贴现框架，证明了最优路径的单调性和稳态的初始条件依赖性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为分析内生时间偏好下的经济动态提供了灵活框架，揭示了贫困陷阱的持续性特征。

title: Imperfect Information and Slow Recoveries in the Labor Market

detail.title: Imperfect Information and Slow Recoveries in the Labor Market

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: International Finance Discussion Papers (Topic)

detail.abstract: The unemployment rate remains elevated long after recessions, a persistence that standard search-and-matching models cannot explain. I show that noise shocks—expectational errors due to the noise in received signals about aggregate shocks—account for much of this sluggishness. Using a structural VAR, I find that absent noise shocks unemployment would have recovered to its pre-recession level six quarters earlier over 1968–2019. To interpret this evidence, I develop a search-and-matching model with on-the-job search, endogenous search effort, and wage rigidity. Embedding imperfect information generates two channels of persistence: slow learning amplifies the effects of persistent productivity shocks, and noise shocks provide an additional source of sluggishness, further magnified by sticky wages and vacancy posting. The model successfully replicates both the slow recovery of unemployment and systematic forecast errors, highlighting imperfect information as a key mechanism behind post-recession labor market dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现噪声冲击（由接收到的关于总体冲击信号中的噪声引起的预期误差）是解释衰退后失业率持续高企的关键机制。通过结构VAR分析发现，如果没有噪声冲击，失业率会在1968-2019年间提前六个季度恢复到衰退前水平。作者构建了包含在职搜索、内生搜索努力和工资刚性的搜索匹配模型，证明不完全信息通过缓慢学习和噪声冲击两个渠道产生持续性。
AI.research_question: 噪声冲击如何解释衰退后失业率的持续高企现象？
AI.motivation: 标准搜索匹配模型无法解释衰退后失业率长期保持高位的持续性现象
AI.theoretical_framework: 搜索匹配模型、不完全信息理论、噪声冲击理论、工资刚性理论
AI.method: 结构VAR分析、构建包含在职搜索、内生搜索努力和工资刚性的搜索匹配模型
AI.findings: 噪声冲击解释了失业率恢复缓慢的大部分原因；没有噪声冲击时失业率会提前六个季度恢复；不完全信息通过缓慢学习和噪声冲击两个渠道产生持续性
AI.theory_contributions: 将不完全信息机制引入搜索匹配模型，揭示了噪声冲击在失业持续性中的关键作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解衰退后劳动力市场动态提供了新的理论框架，对政策制定者预测和应对失业问题具有指导意义

title: The Hidden Tradeoffs in Promoting Impure Public Goods: Evidence from a Field Experiment with Farmers
affiliations: University of Guelph and Wichita State University

detail.title: The Hidden Tradeoffs in Promoting Impure Public Goods: Evidence from a Field Experiment with Farmers
detail.abstract: Impure public goods present a unique challenge for policies aimed at encouraging their adoption. We examine the effectiveness of emphasizing key characteristics of these goods: private benefits, public local benefits, and public global benefits. To test these effects, we conduct a large-scale field experiment in which agricultural producers participate in cost-share bidding for nitrogen stabilizers, a critical impure public good. Our findings reveal that emphasizing private benefits significantly increases bids, followed by public local benefits, whereas public global benefits have an insignificant effect. Interestingly, combining private and public appeals results in lower bids than presenting the private appeal alone, suggesting that public appeals may diminish the effectiveness of private appeals.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过大规模田野实验发现，强调私人利益最能促进不纯公共品的采用，其次是地方公共利益，而全球公共利益效果不显著。有趣的是，同时强调私人和公共利益反而会降低效果。
AI.research_question: 强调不纯公共品的哪些特征（私人利益、地方公共利益、全球公共利益）能最有效地促进其采用？
AI.motivation: 不纯公共品同时具有私人和公共利益特征，这为鼓励其采用的政策带来了独特挑战，需要了解不同利益诉求的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不纯公共品理论、行为经济学、环境政策有效性
AI.method: 大规模田野实验，农业生产者参与氮稳定剂的成本分摊投标
AI.findings: 强调私人利益显著提高投标额，其次是地方公共利益，全球公共利益效果不显著。同时强调私人和公共利益反而比单独强调私人利益效果差。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了不纯公共品采用中不同利益诉求的相对有效性，发现公共利益诉求可能削弱私人利益诉求的效果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了优化不纯公共品推广策略的实证依据，建议优先强调私人利益，避免混合诉求可能产生的负面效应。

title: Data, Power and Emissions: The Environmental Cost of AI
affiliations: University of Bergamo, University of Bergamo - Department of Economics, University of Bergamo and

detail.title: Data, Power and Emissions: The Environmental Cost of AI

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study the environmental impact of artificial intelligence (AI) using a novel dataset that links measures of AI penetration, the location of data centers and power plants, and CO2 emissions across US commuting zones between 2002 and 2022. Our analysis yields four main findings. First, exploiting a shift–share identification strategy, we show that localities more exposed to AI experience relatively faster emissions growth. Second, decomposition results indicate that scale effects dominate, while changes in industrial composition exert at most a weak mitigating effect; at the same time, electricity generation becomes more carbon intensive. Third, AI penetration raises dependence on non-renewable electricity. Fourth, proximity to data centers is a key driver of this effect, as nearby power plants shift toward greater fossil fuel use. These findings suggest that, absent a rapid decarbonization of power generation, the diffusion of AI is likely to exacerbate environmental externalities through the energy demand of data centers.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用2002-2022年美国通勤区数据，发现AI渗透会加剧碳排放增长，主要驱动因素是数据中心附近的发电厂转向更多使用化石燃料，表明除非电力生产快速脱碳，否则AI扩散可能通过数据中心的能源需求加剧环境外部性。
AI.research_question: 人工智能（AI）的环境影响是什么？具体而言，AI渗透如何影响碳排放？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术的快速发展和广泛应用，理解其对环境的影响变得日益重要，特别是AI系统（如数据中心）的能源消耗可能对碳排放产生显著影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于环境经济学和产业组织理论，分析技术扩散对环境的外部性影响，特别关注规模效应、产业结构变化和能源结构转变。
AI.method: 使用2002-2022年美国通勤区面板数据，结合AI渗透度、数据中心位置、发电厂位置和CO2排放数据，采用shift-share识别策略进行因果推断。
AI.findings: 1）AI暴露程度高的地区碳排放增长更快；2）规模效应主导，产业结构变化缓解作用微弱，同时发电碳强度增加；3）AI渗透增加对非可再生电力的依赖；4）数据中心邻近性是关键驱动因素，附近发电厂转向更多化石燃料使用。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化AI技术扩散的环境外部性，揭示了数据中心能源需求通过影响发电结构加剧碳排放的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供证据，强调在AI技术推广过程中需要配套电力部门脱碳政策，以避免环境代价。

title: Can LLMs Credibly Transform the Creation of Panel Data from Diverse Historical Tables
affiliations: , Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia

detail.title: Can LLMs Credibly Transform the Creation of Panel Data from Diverse Historical Tables

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Philadelphia Working Paper No. 25-28
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Multimodal LLMs offer a watershed change for the digitization of historical tables, enabling low-cost processing centered on domain expertise rather than technical skills. We rigorously validate an LLM-based pipeline on a new panel of historical county-level vehicle registrations. This pipeline is estimated to be 100 times less expensive than outsourcing options, reduces critical parsing errors from 40% to 0.3%, and matches human-validated gold standard data with an R2 of 98.6%. Analyses of growth and persistence in vehicle adoption are statistically indistinguishable whether using LLM or gold standard data. LLM-based digitization unlocks complex historical tables, enabling new economic analyses and broader researcher participation.

AI.tldr: 基于多模态大语言模型的历史表格数字化方法，成本降低100倍，关键解析错误从40%降至0.3%，与人工验证数据的R2达到98.6%，在车辆采用增长和持续性分析中与黄金标准数据统计无差异。
AI.research_question: 多模态大语言模型能否有效且低成本地数字化历史表格？
AI.motivation: 传统历史表格数字化成本高且技术要求高，多模态LLMs提供了以领域专业知识为中心的低成本处理方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多模态大语言模型在历史文档数字化中的应用框架
AI.method: 基于LLM的数字化流水线，在县级历史车辆登记面板数据上进行验证
AI.findings: LLM流水线成本比外包低100倍，关键解析错误从40%降至0.3%，与黄金标准数据R2达98.6%，在统计分析中与人工验证数据无显著差异
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了多模态LLMs在历史表格数字化中的有效性，为历史经济数据分析提供了新方法
AI.practical_contributions: 大幅降低历史表格数字化成本，使更多研究者能够参与复杂历史表格的分析，促进经济历史研究

title: Lending Relationships in Loan Renegotiation
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB) - Directorate General Research

detail.title: Lending Relationships in Loan Renegotiation
detail.abstract: This paper presents evidence that personal relationships between corporate borrowers and bank loan officers improve the outcomes of loan renegotiation. Analyzing a bank reorganization in Greece, I find that firms that experience an exogenous interruption in their loan officer relationship confront three consequences: one, the firms are less likely to renegotiate their loans; two, conditional on renegotiation, the firms are given tougher loan terms; and three, the firms are more likely to alter their capital structure. These results point to the importance of lending relationships in mitigating the cost of distress for borrowers in loan renegotiations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过希腊银行重组事件研究发现，企业贷款客户经理关系的意外中断会导致贷款重新谈判概率降低、条件更苛刻，并促使企业改变资本结构，证明了借贷关系在减轻借款人困境成本中的重要性。
AI.research_question: 企业贷款客户经理之间的个人关系如何影响贷款重新谈判的结果？
AI.motivation: 探讨借贷关系中个人关系在贷款重新谈判过程中的作用，特别是在企业面临困境时这种关系的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关系借贷理论、信息不对称理论、贷款重新谈判理论
AI.method: 利用希腊银行重组作为自然实验，分析贷款客户经理关系外生中断对企业贷款重新谈判的影响
AI.findings: 1. 贷款客户经理关系中断的企业重新谈判贷款的可能性降低；2. 即使重新谈判成功，贷款条件也更苛刻；3. 企业更可能改变资本结构
AI.theory_contributions: 为关系借贷理论提供了实证支持，揭示了个人关系在贷款重新谈判中的具体作用机制
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了银行客户关系管理的重要性，为企业维护良好银行关系提供了实践指导

title: Infrastructure Investment Performance and the Macro Economy
affiliations: Tilburg University

detail.title: Infrastructure Investment Performance and the Macro Economy
detail.abstract: Using more than two decades of international data, we examine often mentioned but rarely investigated infrastructure preconceptions by mapping the relations between core macroeconomic indicators and infrastructure investment performance. The findings indicate that listed infrastructure has overall been resilient to rising inflation, although this varies by sector, depending on the business model, regulation, and geography. Capital-intensive sectors like energy, utilities, and renewables benefit from their ability to pass through costs to consumers. Economic growth benefits all infrastructure sectors, especially energy and transport. Lastly, infrastructure companies are generally well protected against rising interest rates, except for the transport sector, which is relatively vulnerable. Infrastructure companies are more sensitive to macroeconomic shifts over different time horizons, particularly in periods of abnormal inflation. These outcomes are crucial for investment portfolio optimizations.

AI.tldr: 基于20多年国际数据的研究表明，上市基础设施整体对通胀具有韧性，但不同行业表现各异；资本密集型行业能转嫁成本；经济增长对所有基础设施行业都有利；除交通行业外，基础设施公司普遍能抵御利率上升；基础设施公司在不同时间范围内对宏观经济变化敏感，特别是在异常通胀时期。
AI.research_question: 核心宏观经济指标与基础设施投资绩效之间的关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究经常被提及但很少被调查的基础设施投资先入之见，为投资组合优化提供关键见解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基础设施投资与宏观经济指标关系的理论框架，包括通胀传导机制、成本转嫁能力、利率敏感性等。
AI.method: 使用超过20年的国际数据进行分析，考察不同行业基础设施投资的表现。
AI.findings: 1) 上市基础设施整体对通胀具有韧性，但不同行业表现各异；2) 资本密集型行业（能源、公用事业、可再生能源）能转嫁成本；3) 经济增长对所有基础设施行业都有利，特别是能源和交通；4) 除交通行业外，基础设施公司普遍能抵御利率上升；5) 基础设施公司在不同时间范围内对宏观经济变化敏感。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了基础设施投资与宏观经济指标关系的实证证据，填补了该领域研究空白，深化了对基础设施投资韧性的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供基础设施投资组合优化的关键见解，帮助识别不同行业在宏观经济变化中的风险敞口和机会。

title: Ethnic Decentralization in Kosovo

detail.title: Ethnic Decentralization in Kosovo
detail.abstract: The Declaration of Independence of Kosovo on February 17, 2008 was based on the so-called "Ahtisaari package", prepared by the envoy of the General Secretary of the United Nations, Martti Ahtisaari. The general conditions were related to the democratic and multi-ethnic nature of the state, but particularly they had to do with the granting and guaranteeing the rights of national minorities or minority communities as referred to the document. Among other elements, the proposal presumed that through decentralization of local government and the foundation of new municipalities where minority communities live, to guarantee their self-government as a process of acceptance and integration in the state of Kosovo. The aim of this paper is to demonstrate that decentralization and the foundation of new municipalities, especially the Serb community in Kosovo, more than helped with their self-government has led to their disintegration and isolation, deepen even more the separation from the ethnic majority population in Kosovo. The Association of Serb municipalities reached in Brussels on August 2015, demonstrates the tendency of the local Serb municipalities to connect to an autonomous political organisation, as a preliminary phase towards the total boycott of the Kosovo state.

AI.tldr: 科索沃独立后的权力下放和设立新自治市政策，特别是针对塞尔维亚社区的措施，不仅未能促进其自治和整合，反而导致了该社区的分离和孤立，加深了与科索沃主体民族的隔阂。
AI.research_question: 科索沃的权力下放政策和设立新自治市是否真正促进了少数民族的自洽和整合？
AI.motivation: 基于联合国特使阿赫蒂萨里提出的"阿赫蒂萨里方案"，科索沃在独立后实施了权力下放和设立新自治市的政策，旨在保障少数民族权利。但实际效果可能与预期相悖。
AI.theoretical_framework: 少数民族自治理论、权力下放理论、民族整合理论
AI.method: 案例分析，以科索沃塞尔维亚社区为研究对象，分析2015年塞尔维亚自治市协会的成立及其影响
AI.findings: 权力下放和设立新自治市政策反而导致了塞尔维亚社区的分离和孤立，加深了与阿尔巴尼亚族主体人口的隔阂，塞尔维亚自治市协会的成立表明其倾向于建立自治政治组织，作为完全抵制科索沃国家的初步阶段
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统权力下放理论在民族冲突地区的适用性，揭示了在高度分裂的社会中，权力下放可能加剧民族隔离而非促进整合
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际社会在处理类似民族冲突地区的自治安排时提供警示，强调需要更全面的整合策略而非单纯的地理分权

title: Perceiving Central Bank Communications through Press Coverage
affiliations: Banco de España and Banco de España

detail.title: Perceiving Central Bank Communications through Press Coverage

publicationDetails.detailsText: Banco de Espana Working Paper No. 2505
publicationDetails.journalName: Banco de Espana Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We present evidence suggesting that a simple measure of central bank communication tone, as perceived and interpreted by the media, correlates with the performance of financial assets and market participants’ expectations. This correlation appears even stronger than that of indices constructed using more complex models, such as a large language models like BERT. We employ a straightforward quantitative index, inspired by the well-known Baker, Bloom and Davis (2016) paper, using a “bag of words” approach and semantic orientation to measure this media-perceived tone orientation in terms of dovishness or hawkishness. Our approach, which emphasises the perception by the press media, contrasts with previous research that focused primarily on central bank minutes or speeches. Our preliminary findings reveal a statistically significant correlation with the movements of 2, 5 and 10-year US Treasury yields, with reactions being faster and more pronounced for shorter maturities. Our index also shows a leading correlation with some measures of inflation expectations, investor sentiment proxies, the stock market and the dollar. Additionally, to account for the impact of COVID-19, we propose the use of Google search trends as a proxy variable.

AI.tldr: 本文发现基于媒体报道感知的央行沟通语调简单指标与金融资产表现和市场预期相关，相关性比复杂模型构建的指标更强。该指标与美债收益率、通胀预期、投资者情绪等存在显著相关性。
AI.research_question: 媒体报道感知的央行沟通语调如何影响金融资产表现和市场参与者预期？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注央行会议纪要和演讲，而忽视了媒体对央行沟通的解读和传播作用。需要探索媒体感知的央行语调对市场的实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Baker、Bloom和Davis(2016)的文本分析方法，采用"词袋"方法和语义导向来衡量媒体感知的鸽派或鹰派语调导向。
AI.method: 使用简单的定量指数，采用"词袋"方法和语义导向，结合Google搜索趋势作为COVID-19影响的代理变量。
AI.findings: 媒体感知的央行语调与2年、5年和10年期美债收益率变动存在统计显著相关性，短期期限反应更快更明显；与通胀预期、投资者情绪、股市和美元存在领先相关性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于媒体感知的央行沟通语调测量方法，强调媒体在信息传播中的中介作用，为央行沟通研究提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市场参与者提供了简单有效的央行沟通语调监测工具，有助于更好地预测市场反应和制定投资策略。

title: Memory and the cross-section of stock returns
affiliations: Sabanci University

detail.title: Memory and the cross-section of stock returns
detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of associative recall on the cross-section of stock returns in the US equity market. Utilizing a novel measure of return expectations rooted in memory, we show that stock-level cues such as monthly returns, return volatility and abnormal trading volume prompt investors to recall past experiences. Investors allocate memory weights to these past experiences depending on how closely they resemble current cue values. Consequently, returns following those past experiences more similar to current cues strongly influence the future return expectations formed today. Investors overvalue those stocks with higher (lower) memory-based return expectations so that they earn lower (higher) future returns. We show that the memory effect is more pronounced for small-cap stocks with higher arbitrage costs and a higher likelihood to be mispriced. These findings remain robust after controlling for behavioral anomalies, established asset pricing factors, risk proxies and firm-specific attributes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了关联性回忆对美国股市横截面收益的影响。通过基于记忆的收益预期新度量，发现投资者会根据当前市场线索（如月度收益、收益波动率和异常交易量）回忆过去经验，并形成未来收益预期。投资者会高估那些基于记忆预期较高的股票，导致这些股票未来收益较低。
AI.research_question: 关联性回忆如何影响股票横截面收益？
AI.motivation: 理解投资者基于记忆形成收益预期的机制及其对资产定价的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于记忆的资产定价理论、行为金融学、关联性回忆理论
AI.method: 使用基于记忆的收益预期新度量方法，分析股票层面的市场线索与投资者记忆权重的关系
AI.findings: 投资者会高估基于记忆预期较高的股票，导致这些股票未来收益较低；记忆效应在小市值股票中更显著
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于记忆的资产定价新理论框架，扩展了行为金融学理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了理解市场定价偏差的新视角，有助于改进投资决策

title: Sailing through troubled waters: Evidence from support discontinuities to firms in times of crisis
affiliations: , University of Lisbon - ISEG School of Economics and Management and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Sailing through troubled waters: Evidence from support discontinuities to firms in times of crisis
detail.abstract: We exploit the assignment mechanism of the APOIAR Program, a targeted initiative aimedat supporting the firms most affected during the COVID-19 pandemic, to provide causal evidenceon the impact of grants on firm survival and performance in times of crisis. Using sharp andfuzzy regression discontinuity designs and drawing on a combination of administrative datasets,we find that eligible firms experienced a short-term increase in profitability in 2021, with €1 ofsupport increasing net income by €0.658. However, these effects did not persist into 2022, andwe found no significant changes in turnover or cost reduction, indicating that the increase inprofitability was mechanically due to the subsidy. Firms allocated part of the grant to rentalpayments and purchases of office supplies, including modest investments in digitalization. Ourfindings suggest that these funds were particularly important for ex-ante less productive, withless cash on hand, and more indebted firms.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用APOIAR计划（针对COVID-19疫情期间受影响最严重企业的定向支持计划）的分配机制，通过断点回归设计提供关于危机时期补助金对企业生存和绩效影响的因果证据。研究发现，合格企业在2021年短期盈利能力有所提升，但效果未持续到2022年，且未发现营业额或成本减少的显著变化。资金主要用于租金支付和办公用品采购，对事前生产率较低、现金较少和负债较多的企业尤为重要。
AI.research_question: 在危机时期，政府补助金对企业生存和绩效的因果影响是什么？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情期间，政府实施了大量支持企业的计划，但关于这些补助金对企业实际影响的因果证据有限，特别是关于其有效性和持续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业生存理论、政府干预理论和资源基础观，探讨危机时期外部资金注入对企业绩效的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用锐利断点回归和模糊断点回归设计，结合多个行政数据集，分析APOIAR计划分配机制下的企业表现。
AI.findings: 1欧元支持使净收入增加0.658欧元，但效果仅出现在2021年，未持续到2022年；未发现营业额或成本减少的显著变化；企业将资金用于租金支付、办公用品采购和适度数字化投资；对事前生产率较低、现金较少和负债较多的企业影响更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了危机时期政府补助对企业绩效影响的因果证据，揭示了补助效果的短期性和机械性特征，丰富了关于政府干预有效性的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计危机应对措施提供实证依据，建议关注补助的针对性分配，特别是对脆弱企业的支持，并考虑补助的持续性影响。

title: "There is Nothing We Can Do" for some and "I Can do everything" for Others : AI Revolution and Perceived Behavioral Control across Social Classes in the D.R.Congo
affiliations: Université Libre des Pays des Grands Lacs

detail.title: "There is Nothing We Can Do" for some and "I Can do everything" for Others : AI Revolution and Perceived Behavioral Control across Social Classes in the D.R.Congo
detail.abstract: Anticipating disruptive technologies often reveals deep social divides in how individuals interpret change. This paper examines the psychological consequences of imagining an Artificial Intelligence (AI) revolution in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with particular attention to perceived behavioral control (PBC). Drawing on the Theory of Planned Behavior, we conceptualize PBC through two key dimensions: self-efficacy and locus of control. Using a randomized experimental design with treatment, placebo, and control conditions, participants were primed with narratives of AI disruption, after which shifts in their sense of agency were measured. Findings indicate that AI primes significantly reduced perceptions of controllability, especially among disadvantaged groups, while self-efficacy remained largely stable. Conversely, individuals with relative advantages, proxied by car ownership and male gender, demonstrated resilience, and in certain cases even a rebound effect, suggesting that access to material and symbolic resources protects against the disempowering effects of disruptive change. These results underscore a critical psychological cleavage: whereas advantaged participants are inclined to view AI as opportunity, marginalized participants experience it as an uncontrollable threat. The study contributes to debates on inequality, perceived behavioral control, and technology adoption by revealing how social class moderates psychological responses to anticipated technological transformations. Policy implications emphasize that reducing inequality requires not only digital infrastructure and skill-building, but also the cultivation of psychological resources such as Locus of control, inclusion, and self-efficacy to mitigate the risk of AI amplifying existing divides.

AI.tldr: 本文通过随机实验研究发现，在刚果民主共和国，AI技术变革的预期会显著降低弱势群体的控制感感知，而优势群体则表现出心理韧性甚至反弹效应，揭示了社会阶层在调节技术变革心理反应中的关键作用。
AI.research_question: AI技术变革预期如何影响个体的感知行为控制，以及社会阶层如何调节这种影响？
AI.motivation: 探究颠覆性技术预期可能揭示的社会分化，特别是在AI革命背景下，不同社会群体对变革的心理反应差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 计划行为理论，重点关注感知行为控制的两个关键维度：自我效能感和控制点。
AI.method: 采用随机实验设计，包含处理组、安慰剂组和对照组，通过AI颠覆性叙事启动，测量参与者控制感的变化。
AI.findings: AI启动显著降低了控制感感知，特别是弱势群体；而优势群体（以汽车所有权和男性性别为代理）表现出韧性甚至反弹效应；社会阶层调节了AI预期的心理影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了社会阶层在调节技术变革心理反应中的作用机制，深化了对感知行为控制理论的理解，特别是在技术颠覆性变革背景下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策启示强调，减少不平等不仅需要数字基础设施和技能建设，还需要培养控制点、包容性和自我效能感等心理资源，以防止AI加剧现有社会分化。

title: Foreign Exchange Rate Dynamics under Regime Uncertainty
affiliations: Universidad del CEMA and University of Texas at El Paso

detail.title: Foreign Exchange Rate Dynamics under Regime Uncertainty
detail.abstract: Exchange rates reflect macroeconomic fundamentals, which in turn are regime dependent. In politically unstable countries, expectations of regime change can have a significant impact on exchange rate dynamics. We exploit Argentina's unexpected 2019 primary election results as a natural experiment to gauge the impact of a change in such expectations. When populist candidate Alberto Fernández's victory margin (15.6%) doubled pre-election polling predictions (7.2%), financial markets immediately recalculated the probability of a change in regime. Using parallel market exchange rates, we estimate that the real exchange rate differential between populist and non-populist regimes exceeds 100%. This large gap creates extreme political sensitivity: regime change expectations of 7-16% can trigger 10% exchange rate movements. Our findings help explain persistent exchange rate volatility in emerging economies and highlight the limitations of purely macroeconomic stabilization approaches when political sustainability is uncertain.

AI.tldr: 本文利用阿根廷2019年初选结果作为自然实验，研究政权更迭预期对汇率的影响。研究发现民粹主义政权与非民粹主义政权之间的实际汇率差异超过100%，政权更迭预期变化7-16%可引发10%的汇率波动。
AI.research_question: 政权更迭预期如何影响新兴经济体的汇率动态？
AI.motivation: 在政治不稳定的国家，政权更迭预期对汇率动态有显著影响，但缺乏实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 汇率反映宏观经济基本面，而基本面又依赖于政治体制。政权更迭预期通过影响市场对经济政策的预期来影响汇率。
AI.method: 利用阿根廷2019年初选结果作为自然实验，使用平行市场汇率数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 民粹主义与非民粹主义政权之间的实际汇率差异超过100%；政权更迭预期变化7-16%可引发10%的汇率波动。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了政治不确定性对汇率动态的重要影响，补充了传统宏观经济汇率理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 解释了新兴经济体持续汇率波动的原因，指出当政治可持续性不确定时，纯粹宏观经济稳定方法的局限性。

title: Predicting Rare Events in Markets with Relational Data
affiliations: Advanced Analytics, Mitchell E. Daniels, Jr School of Business, Purdue University, Advanced Analytics at IQVIA and Advanced Analytics at IQVIA

detail.title: Predicting Rare Events in Markets with Relational Data

declarations.declarationOfInterest: no

detail.abstract: This study presents a modeling framework for predicting rare events in relational data settings. Focusing on the rare disease market, it introduces a factor graph model within a Bayesian classifier that jointly models physician and patient features through their complex visit relationships. The framework is applied to an empirical case focused on identifying physicians treating hereditary angioedema patients, using extensive prescription and medical claims data. Our analysis demonstrates the model's effectiveness, showing it surpasses various benchmark models in identifying rare disease physicians, including those currently recognized in healthcare databases and those likely to emerge in the future. This research contributes to the existing literature by addressing the challenge of predicting rare disease physicians and highlighting the benefits of leveraging relational dependencies among distinct entities to forecast rare events.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个预测关系数据中罕见事件的建模框架，通过贝叶斯分类器中的因子图模型联合建模医生和患者特征及其复杂的就诊关系，在遗传性血管性水肿案例中证明该模型在识别罕见疾病医生方面优于基准模型。
AI.research_question: 如何预测罕见疾病医生？
AI.motivation: 解决预测罕见疾病医生的挑战，利用不同实体间的关系依赖性来预测罕见事件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 因子图模型，贝叶斯分类器，关系数据建模
AI.method: 使用处方和医疗索赔数据，构建因子图模型联合建模医生和患者特征及其就诊关系
AI.findings: 模型在识别罕见疾病医生方面优于各种基准模型，包括当前医疗数据库中已识别的医生和未来可能出现的医生
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了预测关系数据中罕见事件的建模框架，强调了利用实体间关系依赖性预测罕见事件的价值
AI.practical_contributions: 为识别罕见疾病医生提供了有效工具，有助于改善罕见疾病患者的医疗资源分配

title: Managers in the Development of Higher Education in the Republic of Kosovo

detail.title: Managers in the Development of Higher Education in the Republic of Kosovo
detail.abstract: Higher education in the modern world considered specific instrument that promotes the economic development of any country and therefore considered as factors that stimulates productivity and economic efficiency. Practices prove that not every investment in the higher education sector in economic development automatically convert. Even in Kosovo, despite the investment in the system in this segment which continues to be poor and without any progress in development. It is derived insufficient qualified people if at the same time is not reached to create infrastructure, institutions, legislation and motivation system on the concept of professional career. Harmonization of these segments and create the necessary synergy educated and skilled people that entered the market certainly qualitatively affect economic development. From this angle the modern direction of Universities is one of the elements of success for socioeconomic development. Higher Education system in Kosovo continues to face fundamental problems which continually degrade this segment. Evidenced most notably the inability of internal quality assurance, lack of legislation on the management of the university profile and lack of human resources for this feature. To prove this w e analyzed a series of theories about the ways and models of successful management. These have compared the empirical data that emerged from the statistical survey. Indubitably it emerged that the current role of managers in universities is not compatible with social needs and expectations of university employees. Based on these data we have learned that the opinion and expectations of academics is that the direction of the university depends on a combined approach rector menxheriale-academic executive elements respectively. Further, by reliable research has proven that a successful rector except combined approach academic and managerial anyway should also be equipped with additional knowledge in order to be on the needs of social cohesion.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了科索沃高等教育系统在促进经济发展中的角色，发现当前大学管理者的角色与社会需求不符，成功的大学校长需要兼具学术和管理能力，并具备促进社会凝聚力的额外知识。
AI.research_question: 科索沃高等教育系统如何通过有效的管理来促进经济发展？
AI.motivation: 科索沃高等教育系统面临基础性问题，包括内部质量保证不足、缺乏大学管理立法和人力资源短缺，这些问题阻碍了高等教育对经济发展的促进作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成功的大学管理理论和模型
AI.method: 理论分析与统计调查数据比较
AI.findings: 当前大学管理者的角色与社会需求不符；学者期望大学管理采用校长-学术执行元素的组合方法；成功的校长需要兼具学术和管理能力，并具备促进社会凝聚力的知识。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了大学成功管理的组合方法理论，强调学术与管理能力的结合以及社会凝聚力知识的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为科索沃高等教育改革提供了具体建议，包括改善大学管理结构、提升管理者能力，以更好地促进经济发展。

title: The Distribution of Implied Risk Tolerance Across the Lifecycle
affiliations: Morningstar Investment Management, Morningstar Investment Management, Morningstar, Inc. - Morningstar Investment Management LLC and Morningstar Canada

detail.title: The Distribution of Implied Risk Tolerance Across the Lifecycle
detail.abstract: The investor's or household's risk tolerance parameter is a key input in the lifecycle models stemming from Samuelson (1969) and Merton (1969, 1971) as well as the single period mean-variance models stemming from Markowitz (1952, 1959). Using the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) along with empirically informed estimates of nondiscretionary consumption liabilities, human capital, and financial wealth allocations, we infer household economic balance sheets. We then ask, what would the risk tolerance coefficient need to be to arrive at the empirically observed values? We are able to do this for 18,015 individuals/households, forming a distribution of empirically implied risk tolerance coefficients at different ages. We then use the implied risk tolerance as a basis for evaluating whether households act in a manner consistent with a key assumption of the lifecycle hypothesis; namely, that risk tolerance is constant over the lifecycle. We find support of this hypothesis in the data. Households have a near constant implied risk tolerance based on their balance sheets and varying implied risk tolerances based on financial wealth, increasing early in life and decreasing afterwards.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用PSID数据和实证估计的非自由支配消费负债、人力资本和金融财富配置，推断家庭经济资产负债表，然后计算得出18,015个家庭/个人的风险容忍系数分布。研究发现家庭的风险容忍度在整个生命周期中基本保持恒定，支持生命周期假说。
AI.research_question: 家庭的风险容忍系数在生命周期中是否保持恒定？
AI.motivation: 风险容忍参数是Samuelson和Merton生命周期模型以及Markowitz均值-方差模型的关键输入，但关于风险容忍度在生命周期中是否恒定的实证证据有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Samuelson (1969)、Merton (1969, 1971)的生命周期模型和Markowitz (1952, 1959)的均值-方差模型。
AI.method: 使用收入动态面板研究(PSID)数据，结合非自由支配消费负债、人力资本和金融财富配置的实证估计，推断家庭经济资产负债表，计算隐含风险容忍系数。
AI.findings: 基于资产负债表的隐含风险容忍度在生命周期中基本恒定，而基于金融财富的隐含风险容忍度在生命早期增加，之后下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 为生命周期假说中风险容忍度恒定的假设提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融规划和投资建议提供了关于家庭风险偏好的实证依据，有助于更准确地评估家庭的投资决策行为。

title: India-EU Trade Relations: Using Gravity Approach and Counterfactuals
affiliations: Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Kanpur - Department of Economic Sciences

detail.title: India-EU Trade Relations: Using Gravity Approach and Counterfactuals
detail.abstract: This paper explores the concept of Gravity Models and their implications in international trade. We perform our analysis in the context of India-EU trade relations and the roles of FTAs. Our dataset consists of bilateral trade flows between India and the other 27 European Union Nations from 1996 to 2021. Starting from the Na¨ıve Gravity Model, we move towards the Structural Gravity model, dealing with the Multilateral Resistance Terms (MRTs) solved using Poisson Pseudo-Maximum Likelihood with High-Dimensional Fixed Effects (PPMLHDFE). After fitting these models, we extend our results by running counterfactuals of India being a part of the EU, and re-estimate its impacts under the General Equilibrium Poisson Pseudo-Maximum Likelihood (GEPPML) Estimator Model introduced by Anderson, Larch, and Yotov (2018).

AI.tldr: 本文通过引力模型分析印度-欧盟贸易关系，使用PPMLHDFE方法处理多边阻力项，并模拟印度加入欧盟的反事实情景。
AI.research_question: 印度-欧盟贸易关系中引力模型的应用效果如何？自由贸易协定对双边贸易的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 探索引力模型在国际贸易分析中的有效性，特别是印度与欧盟贸易关系的实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 引力模型理论，包括朴素引力模型和结构引力模型，多边阻力项理论。
AI.method: 使用1996-2021年印度与27个欧盟国家的双边贸易数据，采用PPMLHDFE方法估计结构引力模型，并使用GEPPML进行反事实分析。
AI.findings: 结构引力模型能更好地解释印度-欧盟贸易模式，反事实分析显示印度加入欧盟可能带来显著的贸易效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了结构引力模型在处理多边阻力项方面的优越性，扩展了引力模型在发展中国家贸易分析中的应用。

title: Patterns of Deforestation and Forest Fragmentation in Ghana’s Apamprama Forest Reserve: A Remote Sensing-Based Approach

detail.title: Patterns of Deforestation and Forest Fragmentation in Ghana’s Apamprama Forest Reserve: A Remote Sensing-Based Approach
detail.abstract: Forest ecosystems are vital for biodiversity, climate regulation, and community livelihoods, yet they are increasingly threatened by deforestation and fragmentation due to human activities. This study investigates spatial and temporal patterns of land use changes and forest fragmentation in the Apamprama Forest Reserve (AFR) between 1986 and 2024. The objectives of the study were to evaluate the effectiveness of machine learning in land use land cover change classification, identify spatial and temporal deforestation patterns, and assess forest fragmentation caused by illegal mining activities. Using multi-temporal Landsat imagery and Random Forest (RF) classification algorithm in Google Earth Engine (GEE), a higher accuracy was achieved throughout the study period. The study further revealed significant reductions in closed forest area cover, declining from 77% in 1986 to 39% in 2024, primarily due to illegal gold mining and land degradation. Fragmentation metrics indicated alarming trends, where forest patches increased from 2 in 1986 to 77 in 2024, while core forest areas reduced by 46%. Forest connectivity declined heavily, signaling ecosystem isolation and habitat degradation. Key drivers of these changes include illegal mining, and increased illegal logging in AFR, which has intensified the loss of critical ecosystem services such as carbon sequestration and biodiversity conservation. RF classification achieved high accuracy, demonstrating its utility for environmental monitoring. The findings highlight the need for reforestation, stricter enforcement against illegal mining, and community-inclusive conservation strategies to mitigate deforestation impacts and enhance forest resilience in Ghana. This research provides actionable insights for policymakers and practitioners addressing deforestation and forest fragmentation to preserve Ghana’s commons and natural resources.

title: Stock Price Bubbles, Inflation and Monetary Surprises
affiliations: Labcorp, Université Paris VIII Vincennes-Saint-Denis and Athens University of Economics and Business

detail.title: Stock Price Bubbles, Inflation and Monetary Surprises
detail.abstract: This paper examines how U.S. monetary policy shocks influence asset price bubbles under different inflation regimes. Using data from 1998-2023, we show that the transmission of policy is neither constant nor time-invariant. Standard local projection (LP) estimates suggest modest average effects, but including the COVID-19 period reveals that these relationships weaken. Employing time-varying local projections (TVP-LP), we document sharp shifts in transmission during the Global Financial Crisis and the pandemic, motivating a nonlinear approach. Nonlinear VAR-LP estimates uncover clear asymmetries: in high-inflation states, monetary tightening deflates bubbles by raising financing costs and constraining risk-taking; in low-inflation states, the same shocks amplify bubbles by raising expected inflation, narrowing credit spreads, and boosting equity returns. We interpret this inversion as evidence of a state-contingent speculative signaling channel, whereby tightening is perceived as a signal of stronger demand or implicit accommodation, encouraging further speculation. This mechanism highlights that safeguarding financial stability requires more than interest rate adjustments alone-it demands explicit attention to the inflationary environment and investor perceptions.

detail.abstract: We examine the role of autocratic restrictions on property rights in explaining debt financing of infrastructure and the associated credit spreads. We focus on two autocratic powers; the ability to restrict out-migration and the ability to expropriate output. We show how these two restrictions provide a deeper basis for the "democracy advantage," the claim that democracies obtain better financing terms than autocracies. We show theoretically and empirically that restrictions on migration enhance debt repayment, increase the degree to which infrastructure is debt financed, and reduce credit spreads while the ability to expropriate wealth has the opposite affect.

title: Battle of the Ages: Distributional and Aggregate Effects of Monetary Policy in a Model with Age Demographics
affiliations: London School of Economics, European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB) and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Battle of the Ages: Distributional and Aggregate Effects of Monetary Policy in a Model with Age Demographics

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: We develop a model in which agents face unemployment risk, but also age and eventually retire. We study the impact of different retirement schemes on life-cycle consumption and the monetary transmission mechanism. Agents save because of a fall in income upon retirement, changes along the life-cycle wage profile, and unemployment risk. Changes in retirement policies affect the distribution of available assets (bonds) among the middle aged and the young, which in turn can have a strong impact on the ability of the young to insure themselves against unemployment risk. Interestingly, it is possible that an increase in retirement benefits leads to higher consumption levels during sustained unemployment spells even though the associated increase in taxes reduces unemployment benefits. The reason is that this policy induces the middle aged to save less which leaves more of the available asset supply to the young. A reduction in the interest rate has a bigger impact on those for whom labor market conditions improve the most and – due to a larger negative income effect – has a smaller impact on those who save more. In terms of the aggregate impact of monetary-policy shocks, our paper confirms conventional wisdom that the expansion is magnified in the presence of incomplete markets, since it is then accompanied by a fall in precautionary savings. The novel aspect of our analysis is that the extent of the incompleteness, i.e., the ability of those subject to unemployment risk to insure themselves, is endogenous. Specifically, it is reduced as the young (middle-aged) hold a larger (smaller) fraction of the available asset supply and this distribution is not only affected by retirement policies, but also by government bond supply and the life-cycle wage profile. Thus, understanding the distribution of assets across different age cohorts is not only important for understanding life-cycle consumption patterns, but also business cycles.

detail.abstract: This study explores the temporal preferences for the vaccination of COVID-like diseases (CLD) in Wuhan, China, through a discrete choice experiment (DCE). Unlike previous literature, which relied on stated preference method with limited real-world applicability, this research uses the DCE method to simulate realistic decision making. The study uniquely uses the DCE approach to estimate and compare hyperbolic and exponential discount rates for CLD vaccination, which fills critical gaps in the use of DCE to calculate temporal discount rates for vaccination. Our results show a steep discount rate in the vaccination of CLD for hyperbolic (0.225) and exponential (0.16) compared to previous research. The discount rate for CLD vaccination shows heterogeneity in demographics, health behaviors, health conditions, and levels of government trust. We do not find significant differences in gender, medical resources, and previous vaccine reaction. Some customized policy insights aimed at building immediate herd immunity for future outbreaks are informed by the findings of this study.

publicationDetails.detailsText: TIAA Institute Research Paper Series Forthcoming

detail.abstract: Stress has a significant impact on health outcomes. And while the connection between health and wealth is well studied, the connection between financial security and stress is less studied. We examine how self-reported financial security is related to reported stress across 11 household areas with survey evidence. We find subjective financial security is highly correlated to self-reported stress. Individuals reporting relatively lower financial security are significantly more likely to report stress and do so across more areas and with greater intensity. When controlling for financial security, there are limited stress differences between males and females on the extensive margin, with some differences in intensity. There are no significant financial security differences by age, but younger individuals are more likely to report stress with greater intensity. Differences across age groups may be explained by younger workers having greater lifecycle uncertainty compared to older workers. Household income has little explanatory power once controlling for financial security. Our results highlight the importance of subjective measures, and how subjective financial measures impact life in other domains, and the importance of benefit programs that promote financial security and stress management.

AI.research_question: 自我报告的财务安全感如何影响报告的压力水平？
AI.motivation: 虽然健康与财富的关系已被充分研究，但财务安全感与压力之间的联系研究较少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生命周期不确定性理论，主观财务感知对生活其他领域的影响。
AI.method: 基于11个家庭领域的调查证据进行分析。
AI.findings: 主观财务安全感与自我报告压力高度相关；财务安全感较低者报告更多压力和更高强度；控制财务安全感后，性别差异有限；年龄无显著财务安全感差异，但年轻人压力更大；家庭收入在控制财务安全感后解释力有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 强调主观测量指标的重要性，揭示主观财务措施如何影响生活其他领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调促进财务安全感和压力管理的福利计划的重要性。

reference: TIAA Institute Research Paper Series Forthcoming
title: Do Misperceptions About Medicare Coverage Explain Low Demand for Long-Term Care Insurance?
affiliations: Department of Economics, University of South Florida, Swarthmore College, Swarthmore College, University of South Florida and Independent

detail.title: Do Misperceptions About Medicare Coverage Explain Low Demand for Long-Term Care Insurance?

publicationDetails.detailsText: TIAA Institute Research Paper Series Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: TIAA Institute Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Long-term care represents a significant financial risk for elderly individuals. Despite this risk, only 14% of those age 60 and over have private long-term care insurance (LTCI), and about one-third of all longterm care expenses in the United Staes are paid for out of pocket. In this study, we examine whether misperceptions about Medicare coverage explain the low demand for LTCI. Surveys of older Americans find that about 40% of individuals believe that Medicare will pay for long-term care. However, Medicare only provides limited coverage of short-term stays in skilled nursing facilities following a qualifying hospital stay. Using a regression discontinuity design (RDD) based on eligibility for Medicare at age 65, we document a statistically significant increase in private LTCI coverage rates at the time of enrollment in Medicare. A potential explanation for this increase is that, during the process of enrolling in Medicare, individuals learn that Medicare doesn't cover long-term care services and consequently purchase private LTCI. Using data from two unique surveys on planning for long-term care, we also find that knowledge of Medicare coverage of long-term care services improves at age 65, providing support for the misperception hypothesis.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了老年人对医疗保险覆盖范围的误解是否解释了长期护理保险需求低的原因。研究发现，40%的老年人误以为医疗保险会支付长期护理费用，但实际上医疗保险只覆盖短期护理。通过断点回归设计，发现在65岁符合医疗保险资格时，私人长期护理保险覆盖率显著增加，支持了误解假说。
AI.research_question: 对医疗保险覆盖范围的误解是否解释了长期护理保险需求低的原因？
AI.motivation: 长期护理对老年人构成重大财务风险，但只有14%的60岁以上老年人拥有私人长期护理保险，约三分之一的长期护理费用由个人自付。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学中的认知偏差理论，特别是关于保险覆盖范围的误解如何影响保险购买决策。
AI.method: 使用断点回归设计（RDD）基于65岁符合医疗保险资格的条件，分析私人长期护理保险覆盖率的变化；同时使用两项关于长期护理规划的独特调查数据。
AI.findings: 在65岁符合医疗保险资格时，私人长期护理保险覆盖率显著增加；对医疗保险长期护理服务覆盖范围的知识在65岁时有所改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 为保险需求理论提供了行为经济学视角的补充，揭示了认知偏差在保险购买决策中的重要作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了改善老年人长期护理保险覆盖的策略，建议通过教育干预纠正对医疗保险覆盖范围的误解。

title: Q-Learning–Driven Adaptive Rewiring for Cooperative Control in Heterogeneous Networks
affiliations: National Taiwan University and Lehigh University

detail.title: Q-Learning–Driven Adaptive Rewiring for Cooperative Control in Heterogeneous Networks
detail.abstract: Cooperation emergence in multi-agent systems represents a fundamental statistical physics problem where microscopic learning rules drive macroscopic collective behavior transitions. We propose a Q-learning-based variant of adaptive rewiring that builds on mechanisms studied in the literature. This method combines temporal difference learning with network restructuring so that agents can optimize strategies and social connections based on interaction histories. Through neighbor-specific Q-learning, agents develop sophisticated partnership management strategies that enable cooperator cluster formation, creating spatial separation between cooperative and defective regions. Using power-law networks that reflect real-world heterogeneous connectivity patterns, we evaluate emergent behaviors under varying rewiring constraint levels, revealing distinct cooperation patterns across parameter space rather than sharp thermodynamic transitions. Our systematic analysis identifies three behavioral regimes: a permissive regime (low constraints) enabling rapid cooperative cluster formation, an intermediate regime with sensitive dependence on dilemma strength, and a patient regime (high constraints) where strategic accumulation gradually optimizes network structure. Comparative analysis against Bush-Mosteller stimulusresponse learning demonstrates that Q-learning’s temporal credit assignment capabilities produce superior cooperation outcomes, particularly under intermediate rewiring constraints where long-term relationship assessment becomes crucial. Simulation results show that while moderate constraints create transition-like zones that suppress cooperation, fully adaptive rewiring enhances cooperation levels through systematic exploration of favorable network configurations. Quantitative analysis reveals that increased rewiring frequency drives large-scale cluster formation with power-law size distributions. Our results establish a new paradigm for understanding intelligencedriven cooperation pattern formation in complex adaptive systems, revealing how machine learning serves as an alternative driving force for spontaneous organization in multi-agent networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Q学习的自适应重连方法，结合时间差分学习和网络重构，让智能体能够基于交互历史优化策略和社会连接。在幂律网络中，该方法通过邻居特定的Q学习形成了合作者集群，产生了三种行为模式，相比传统学习方法显著提升了合作水平。
AI.research_question: 基于Q学习的自适应重连机制如何在多智能体系统中促进合作行为的涌现？
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统中的合作涌现是一个基础统计物理问题，微观学习规则驱动宏观集体行为转变。现有方法在处理长期关系评估和网络结构优化方面存在局限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合时间差分学习理论和网络重构理论，通过邻居特定的Q学习机制，让智能体能够同时优化策略和社会连接。
AI.method: 在幂律网络上进行仿真实验，评估不同重连约束水平下的涌现行为，并与Bush-Mosteller刺激响应学习进行对比分析。
AI.findings: 识别了三种行为模式：宽松约束下的快速合作集群形成、中间约束下对困境强度的敏感依赖、严格约束下的战略积累优化网络结构。Q学习在中间约束条件下表现最优。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了智能驱动合作模式形成的新范式，揭示了机器学习作为多智能体网络中自发组织的替代驱动力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为复杂自适应系统中的合作促进提供了新的算法框架，展示了Q学习在长期关系评估和网络结构优化中的优势。

title: Is Baldness Inequality an Analogy for Income Inequality in General Equilibrium?

detail.title: Is Baldness Inequality an Analogy for Income Inequality in General Equilibrium?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or animals, and therefore ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this study.

detail.abstract: We develop an analytic analogy between "baldness inequality" and income inequality to isolate three portable mechanisms: inherited asymmetries with cumulative dynamics, unequal access to mitigation, and aggregate feedback. A basic dynamic law S t+1 = α(1θm)S t + ε t nests heterogeneity, budget constraints, intergenerational learning, and generalequilibrium externalities. Synthetic illustrations show how the composite parameter φ = α(1-θm) governs trajectories and how regressive externalities raise α t , slowing convergence. Policy implications follow directly: early interventions that raise θm at the bottom and reduce regressive externalities are jointly necessary for sustained reductions in S t. A light empirical anchoring (Appendix B) calibrates plausible values and demonstrates robustness to ±10% variation. The framework is parsimonious yet extensible, yielding falsifiable comparative statics and an operational targeting rule. Limits of the analogy are explicit: domains are not ontologically equivalent, and welfare ramifications of income extend beyond the psychosocial effects of baldness.

AI.tldr: 本文通过"秃头不平等"与收入不平等的类比分析，提出了三个可移植机制：继承性不对称与累积动态、不平等缓解途径、以及总体反馈效应。建立了一个基本动态定律S_t+1 = α(1-θm)S_t + ε_t，并推导出政策含义：需要早期干预提高底层的θm并减少回归性外部性。
AI.research_question: 如何通过类比分析来理解收入不平等的动态机制？
AI.motivation: 为理解收入不平等的复杂动态提供一个新的分析框架
AI.theoretical_framework: 类比分析框架、动态系统理论、不平等累积机制
AI.method: 理论建模与类比分析，辅以合成示例和轻量实证校准
AI.findings: 复合参数φ = α(1-θm)控制不平等轨迹，回归性外部性会提高α_t并减缓收敛
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个简约但可扩展的分析框架，产生可证伪的比较静态和操作性目标规则
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定提供了具体指导：早期干预提高底层缓解能力并减少回归性外部性

reference: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 25-048
title: Visibly Fair Mechanisms
affiliations: , ZEW – Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research and Peking University HSBC Business School

detail.title: Visibly Fair Mechanisms

publicationDetails.detailsText: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 25-048
publicationDetails.journalName: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Priority-based allocation often requires eliminating justified envy, making serial dictatorship (SD) the only non-wasteful direct mechanism with that property. However, SD's outcomes can conflict with the policymaker's objectives. We introduce visible fairness, a framework where fairness is evaluated using coarser information. This is achieved by designing message spaces that strategically conceal information that could render desired allocations unfair. We characterize these mechanisms as generalizations of SD, establish conditions for strategy-proofness, and show how to implement distributional constraints. This creates a new trade-off: achieving distributional goals may require limiting preference elicitation, forgoing efficiency gains even when compatible with the constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"可见公平性"框架，通过设计信息空间来战略性地隐藏可能使期望分配不公平的信息，从而在优先分配中实现政策制定者的目标。
AI.research_question: 如何在优先分配中实现政策制定者的目标，同时避免串行独裁机制的局限性？
AI.motivation: 串行独裁机制虽然能够消除合理嫉妒，但其结果可能与政策制定者的目标相冲突，需要新的机制设计方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可见公平性框架，通过信息空间设计来战略性地隐藏信息，将公平性评估建立在更粗糙的信息基础上。
AI.method: 将可见公平性机制特征化为串行独裁机制的泛化，建立策略证明性的条件，并展示如何实现分配约束。
AI.findings: 可见公平性框架创建了新的权衡：实现分配目标可能需要限制偏好获取，即使与约束兼容也会放弃效率收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了可见公平性概念，扩展了串行独裁机制，建立了策略证明性的理论条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实现分配约束的新工具，在公平性和政策目标之间提供了更灵活的平衡。

title: Beyond the Deal: Towards Equity in Music
affiliations: Ebonyi State University and Afe Babalola University

detail.title: Beyond the Deal: Towards Equity in Music
detail.abstract: Artists and record labels are the key players in the music industry. While artists' creativity drives the industry, investments by record labels fuel and control it. As a result of this pivotal relationship, the industry is private in nature, as the relationship between the parties is largely regulated by their contract. In recent years, issues of fair deals, ambiguous clauses, perpetual assignment of copyrights, artist images, stage names, etc., as well as restrictive music contracts, have always been in the news. These issues threaten the industry, increase the risk for potential investors, and complicate the relationship between artists and labels. Hence, the need to address these issues is paramount for the good of the industry.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨音乐产业中艺术家与唱片公司合同关系存在的问题，包括不公平条款、版权永久转让、艺人形象控制等，这些问题威胁行业发展并增加投资风险。
AI.research_question: 音乐产业中艺术家与唱片公司合同关系存在哪些关键问题，如何解决这些问题以促进产业健康发展？
AI.motivation: 近年来音乐产业中频繁出现关于不公平交易、模糊条款、版权永久转让、艺人形象控制等合同问题的报道，这些问题威胁行业发展、增加投资风险，并复杂化了艺术家与唱片公司的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于合同理论、知识产权法和产业组织理论，分析音乐产业中权力不对等关系对合同条款的影响。
AI.method: 文献分析和案例研究，考察音乐产业合同实践中的具体问题和争议。
AI.findings: 发现音乐合同中存在不公平条款、版权永久转让、艺人形象和艺名控制等系统性问题，这些问题损害艺术家权益并阻碍产业发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对创意产业中权力不对称如何影响合同条款的理解，为音乐产业合同改革提供理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为音乐产业利益相关者提供合同改革建议，促进更公平的艺术家-唱片公司关系，降低投资风险，推动产业可持续发展。

title: The Youth Inflation Index: An Empirical Study of Financial Behaviour and Attitudes in Indian Youth
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Youth Inflation Index: An Empirical Study of Financial Behaviour and Attitudes in Indian Youth
detail.abstract:
Indian inflation has reshaped young adults' financial behaviour, yet very few have examined their distinct responses to higher prices. This work introduces the Youth Inflation Index (YII), a composite indicator designed to capture how young Indians aged 12–22 balance saving, expenditure, and awareness of inflation. With survey data from 59 respondents from urban India, YII integrates behavioural and economic dimensions, including the status of pocket money where savings are stored, level of financial confidence, and awareness of inflationary pressures.

The findings indicate that a substantial proportion of young adults are in the "moderate resilience" range, evidencing substantial variations by age, saving behaviour, and availability of formal instruments. Older adolescents and users of banking programs or products have higher resilience, while younger adolescents and savings-in-cash groups are found to have higher risk levels. Qualitative responses in particular emphasised peer influences, electronic pay-in mechanisms, and limited financial literacy.

The research highlights the value of targeted financial literacy, regular allowances, and structural availability of banking and investment instruments. By proposing the YII, this work offers a usable model for youth financial resilience in inflationary environments and opens pathways for policy and teaching interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了青年通胀指数(YII)来衡量印度12-22岁年轻人在通胀环境下的财务韧性，发现大多数年轻人处于中等韧性水平，年龄、储蓄方式和金融工具可获得性是关键影响因素。
AI.research_question: 印度年轻人在通胀环境下如何平衡储蓄、支出和通胀意识？他们的财务韧性如何？
AI.motivation: 印度通胀重塑了年轻人的财务行为，但很少有研究关注他们对高价格的具体应对方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合行为经济学和金融韧性理论，构建包含储蓄行为、支出模式和通胀意识的综合框架。
AI.method: 对印度城市59名受访者进行问卷调查，开发青年通胀指数(YII)这一复合指标。
AI.findings: 大多数年轻人处于中等韧性水平；年长青少年和使用银行产品的群体韧性更高；年轻青少年和现金储蓄群体风险更高；同伴影响、电子支付和有限金融素养是关键因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了青年通胀指数(YII)这一衡量年轻人财务韧性的新模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为针对性金融教育、定期津贴政策以及银行投资工具的结构性可获得性提供了实践建议。

title: A Financial Analysis and Valuation of DIAGEO PLC

detail.title: A Financial Analysis and Valuation of DIAGEO PLC

keywords: Free Cash Flow to the Firm Model

detail.abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive financial analysis and valuation of Diageo plc, a leading global player in the Total Beverage Alcohol (TBA) sector. The primary objective is to assess the intrinsic value of Diageo's equity and provide strategic insights for potential and existing investors. Employing a multi-method valuation framework-including the Dividend Discount Model (DDM), Earnings and Investment Model (EIM), Free Cash Flow to Firm (FCFF) model, and Price-to-Earnings (P/E) multiples approach-the study triangulates Diageo's fair market value as of 30 June 2024. The results suggest a convergence of intrinsic values around the market price of £24.08, indicating fair pricing. To enrich this valuation, the study incorporates a detailed ratio-based financial health assessment. Eight key financial ratios spanning profitability, liquidity, efficiency, and solvency dimensions are analysed using longitudinal and peer benchmarking against four comparable firms: Pernod Ricard, Brown-Forman, Constellation Brands, and Campari. Data is sourced from Capital IQ and verified using author-calculated figures, ensuring methodological rigour. Despite the observed fair pricing, the study identifies several underlying investor concerns, including Diageo's modest net income CAGR (1.38%) and a negative abnormal buy-and-hold return (-34.67%) over the 2021-2024 period. These findings indicate potential macroeconomic or sector-specific headwinds. Nevertheless, the analysis suggests that current investors may benefit from a stabilised entry point, while future valuation upside depends on operational efficiency and margin expansion. The study concludes that Diageo remains a credible long-term investment for incomeseeking investors, supported by its defensive sectoral positioning and stable dividend record. At the same time, value and growth-focused investors may require stronger catalysts before engaging. Overall, this paper contributes a multidimensional evaluation of Diageo's financial positioning and market prospects, with actionable implications for diverse investor profiles.

AI.tldr: 本文对帝亚吉欧公司进行综合财务分析和估值，采用多种估值方法得出其公允价值约为24.08英镑，与市场价格基本一致。研究发现公司财务健康但增长缓慢，适合收入型投资者，但增长型投资者需等待更强催化剂。
AI.research_question: 帝亚吉欧公司的内在股权价值是多少？其当前市场价格是否合理？
AI.motivation: 评估帝亚吉欧作为全球领先酒类公司的投资价值，为现有和潜在投资者提供战略见解
AI.theoretical_framework: 多方法估值框架：股息贴现模型、收益投资模型、自由现金流模型、市盈率倍数法
AI.method: 采用四种估值模型进行交叉验证，结合财务比率分析（8个关键比率），与四家可比公司进行纵向和同行基准比较，数据来源于Capital IQ
AI.findings: 内在价值与市场价格24.08英镑趋同，表明定价合理；但公司净收入复合年增长率仅1.38%，2021-2024年异常买入持有回报为-34.67%
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了多维度估值框架的实证应用，展示了多种估值方法的交叉验证价值
AI.practical_contributions: 为不同类型投资者提供具体投资建议：收入型投资者可考虑当前稳定入场点，增长型投资者需等待更强催化剂

title: Performance of Energy ETFs and Climate Risks
affiliations: , Deakin University and University of Hull

detail.title: Performance of Energy ETFs and Climate Risks
detail.abstract: We investigate whether green (brown) portfolios constructed from clean energy ETFs (fossil fuel ETFs) yield positive (negative) returns conditional on climate-related risks. While the green portfolios do not unconditionally outperform the brown ones, the outperformance of green portfolios is statistically significant under the conditional setting using non-parametric estimates with imposing inequality restrictions. Our conditional studies also show that brown portfolios are riskier than green ones with various measurements. We present the heterogeneity in the effect of climate information on the return and risk of green and brown portfolios. Furthermore, we document that fund flows for green assets are higher than those for brown ones during periods of high climate risks. Our findings are robust to alternative specifications.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，在考虑气候相关风险的条件设置下，绿色投资组合（清洁能源ETF）相比棕色投资组合（化石燃料ETF）能产生显著正回报，且棕色投资组合风险更高。气候风险高时，绿色资产的资金流入更多。
AI.research_question: 绿色投资组合与棕色投资组合在气候相关风险条件下的回报和风险表现如何？
AI.motivation: 研究气候相关风险对绿色和棕色投资组合表现的影响，为投资者在气候变化背景下的投资决策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于气候风险对资产定价影响的理论，探讨绿色与棕色资产在风险暴露和回报特征上的差异。
AI.method: 使用非参数估计方法，在施加不等式限制的条件下进行条件分析，并采用多种风险测量指标。
AI.findings: 1) 在无条件情况下绿色投资组合不优于棕色投资组合；2) 在气候风险条件下绿色投资组合表现显著优于棕色投资组合；3) 棕色投资组合风险高于绿色投资组合；4) 气候风险高时绿色资产资金流入更多。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了气候风险条件下绿色与棕色投资组合表现的异质性理论，丰富了可持续金融和气候金融理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者在气候变化背景下构建投资组合提供实证依据，支持绿色资产在气候风险时期的配置价值。

title: Weekend Information Gaps and Systemic Risk Transmission to Oil Markets: A COVOL-Based Analysis
affiliations: University College Dublin, Dublin City University , Institute for Policy Research (IPR), University of Bath and

detail.title: Weekend Information Gaps and Systemic Risk Transmission to Oil Markets: A COVOL-Based Analysis
detail.abstract: This study examines the transmission of systemic risk to international oil markets by analysing the dynamic connectedness between three distinct Common Volatility (COVOL) measures — Energy, Asset, and Country — and five major oil benchmarks. Utilising a framework using Time-Varying Parameter Vector Autoregression (TVP-VAR), EGARCH, and wavelet coherence analyses, we investigate the presence and characteristics of day-of-the-week effects in these risk relationships. Our findings consistently identify a significant Monday effect, characterised by a pronounced reduction in the dynamic connectedness between the COVOL measures and the analysed oil markets. This weekend-generated discontinuity in information flow is highly state-dependent. During the COVID-19 pandemic, the effect dissipated for Energy and Asset COVOL but intensified for Country COVOL. In contrast, during periods of geopolitical conflict, the negative signal disconnect for Asset and Country COVOL extended into Tuesday, while the effect for Energy COVOL vanished entirely as energy news became part of a continuous, high-alert information stream. Wavelet co- herence analyses corroborate these findings, revealing distinct and evolving lead-lag dynamics and demonstrating significant heterogeneity across the individual oil benchmarks, reflecting their unique sensitivities to regional, consumer, and macroeconomic shocks. The results indicate a hierarchy of influence, where country-level systemic risks exert the strongest effect on oil markets, followed by energy- and asset-level risks.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析三种共同波动率指标与五大石油基准之间的动态关联性，发现系统性风险向国际石油市场传导存在显著的周一效应，表现为风险关联度在周一显著降低。这种效应具有状态依赖性，在COVID-19疫情期间和地缘政治冲突期间表现出不同的变化模式。
AI.research_question: 系统性风险如何通过共同波动率指标向国际石油市场传导？是否存在日间效应？
AI.motivation: 理解系统性风险向石油市场的传导机制，特别是风险关联性的时间动态特征和状态依赖性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统性风险传导理论、共同波动率理论、时间序列分析框架
AI.method: 时变参数向量自回归(TVP-VAR)、EGARCH模型、小波相干分析
AI.findings: 1. 存在显著的周一效应，风险关联度在周一显著降低；2. 效应具有状态依赖性：疫情期间能源和资产COVOL效应消失，但国家COVOL效应增强；地缘冲突期间资产和国家COVOL效应延长至周二，能源COVOL效应消失；3. 国家层面系统性风险对石油市场影响最大，其次是能源和资产层面风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了系统性风险传导的日间效应和状态依赖性，建立了风险传导的层次结构理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为风险管理者和政策制定者提供了系统性风险传导的时间动态特征，有助于优化风险管理和投资决策时机。

title: Artificial Identity: How Instructor Race and Gender Influence Student Behavior and Performance in AI-Mediated Learning
affiliations: Yale University - Law School and Yale University - Law School

detail.title: Artificial Identity: How Instructor Race and Gender Influence Student Behavior and Performance in AI-Mediated Learning
detail.abstract:
As artificial intelligence (AI) transforms education, AI-generated instructors offer unprecedented opportunities to scale and personalize learning. Yet, the influence of instructor identity—especially race and gender—remains underexplored in AI-driven contexts. This study provides one of the first randomized controlled experiments examining how instructor identity shapes student engagement, academic performance, and willingness to pay when instructional content is held constant. Leveraging a large-scale field experiment involving over 2,500 students enrolled in an online Coursera course, we randomly assigned students to video instruction with identical content delivered by either a human professor or one of four AI avatars whose appearance varied by race (Black or White) and gender (male or female). 

The main findings are: First, the avatars were rated similarly to the human professor in teaching effectiveness, and many avatar-instructed students reported that their instructors were likely to be human. There were no significant “man vs. machine” differences in student attrition or grades between the White-male human instructor and the White male avatar. Second, the Black male avatar outperformed the White male avatar with regard to overall course grade (p. = .047), average quiz grade (p. = .099), and number of course items completed (p. = .099). Third, female students that were assigned to female avatars received significantly higher average quiz grades (p. = .042) than those assigned to male avatars. Hispanic students who were assigned to Black avatars were significantly less likely to complete the course (p. = 041) but more likely to have a higher course grade (p. = .043) than Hispanic students assigned to White avatars.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过随机对照实验发现，AI虚拟教师的种族和性别身份显著影响学生参与度、学业表现和付费意愿。黑人男性虚拟教师表现优于白人男性虚拟教师，女性学生在女性虚拟教师指导下成绩更好，而西班牙裔学生在黑人虚拟教师指导下的完成率和成绩呈现矛盾结果。
AI.research_question: AI虚拟教师的种族和性别身份如何影响学生的参与度、学业表现和付费意愿？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术在教育领域的应用日益广泛，AI生成的虚拟教师提供了前所未有的规模化和个性化学习机会，但教师身份（特别是种族和性别）在AI驱动环境中的影响尚未得到充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会身份理论、刻板印象理论和教育技术接受模型，探讨虚拟教师身份特征对学生学习行为的影响机制。
AI.method: 大规模随机对照实验，涉及2,500多名Coursera在线课程学生，随机分配到人类教授或四种不同种族（黑人/白人）和性别（男性/女性）组合的AI虚拟教师组。
AI.findings: 1）虚拟教师与人类教授教学效果评价相似；2）黑人男性虚拟教师在课程成绩、测验成绩和完成项目数量上优于白人男性虚拟教师；3）女性学生在女性虚拟教师指导下测验成绩更高；4）西班牙裔学生在黑人虚拟教师指导下的完成率较低但成绩较高。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在AI教育环境中系统验证教师身份特征的影响，拓展了社会身份理论在虚拟教学环境中的应用，为AI教育中的身份设计提供理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育技术公司设计AI虚拟教师提供实证依据，建议根据学生群体特征优化虚拟教师身份配置，提升教学效果和学生参与度。

title: Reading the Panic: How Investors Perceived Bank Risk During the 2023 Bank Run
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York,  and Federal Reserve Bank New York

detail.title: Reading the Panic: How Investors Perceived Bank Risk During the 2023 Bank Run

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The bank run that started in March 2023 in the U.S. occurred at an unusually rapid pace, suggesting that depositors were surprised by these events. Given that public data revealed bank vulnerabilities as early as 2022:Q1, were other market participants also surprised? In this post, based on a recent paper, we develop a new, high-frequency measure of bank balance sheet risk to examine how stock market investors’ risk sensitivity evolved around the run. We find that stock market investors only became attentive to bank risk after the run and only to the risk of a limited number (less than one-third) of publicly traded banks. Surprisingly, investors seem to have mostly focused on media exposure and not fundamentals when evaluating bank risk. In a companion post, we examine how the Federal Reserve’s liquidity support affected investor risk perceptions.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种高频银行资产负债表风险衡量方法，发现股票市场投资者在2023年3月美国银行挤兑事件后才开始关注银行风险，且主要关注媒体曝光而非基本面因素。
AI.research_question: 在2022年第一季度公开数据已显示银行脆弱性的情况下，其他市场参与者是否也对2023年3月的银行挤兑事件感到意外？
AI.motivation: 2023年3月美国银行挤兑事件以异常迅速的速度发生，表明储户对这些事件感到意外，需要研究其他市场参与者的风险感知。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行风险感知、市场效率理论、投资者行为理论
AI.method: 开发新的高频银行资产负债表风险衡量方法，分析股票市场投资者风险敏感性的演变
AI.findings: 股票市场投资者仅在挤兑后才开始关注银行风险，且仅关注不到三分之一上市银行的风险；投资者主要关注媒体曝光而非基本面因素
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了高频银行风险衡量方法，揭示了投资者风险感知的滞后性和选择性
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和银行风险管理提供了投资者行为洞察，有助于改进风险预警机制

title: Expanding Black Reparations with Human and Social Capital Investments
affiliations: Marquette University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Expanding Black Reparations with Human and Social Capital Investments

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest.

detail.abstract: Disadvantaged social groups in the US suffered disproportionately in the covid pandemic and Great Recession, worsening high levels of inequality associated with their post-1980 declining intergenerational income mobility. For black Americans this reflects the long history of racial discrimination beginning with slavery. Reparations paid to descendants of enslaved individuals to eliminate the black-white wealth gap is a step toward addressing this history. A further needed step is to build predominantly black communities human and social capital through public investments in community health care centers (CHCs) and historically black colleges and universities (HBCUs). There is considerable evidence that investments in early childhood education positively affect later school performance, income and earnings, higher education, crime, and other well-being outcomes. CHCs and HBCUs promote early childhood education. This paper argues compensation is due to both individuals and their communities, and reparations payments should be accompanied by public investments in those communities.

AI.tldr: 本文主张美国应向被奴役者后代支付赔偿金以消除种族财富差距，同时投资黑人社区的医疗中心和传统黑人大学，通过早期教育投资来提升代际收入流动性。
AI.research_question: 如何通过赔偿金和社区投资来消除种族不平等并提升黑人代际收入流动性？
AI.motivation: 美国弱势群体在新冠大流行和经济衰退中遭受不成比例的损失，加剧了1980年后代际收入流动性下降导致的不平等问题，特别是黑人群体因历史上的种族歧视而面临严重不平等。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于种族不平等理论、代际收入流动性理论和社会资本理论，强调历史歧视对当代经济机会的影响。
AI.method: 理论分析和政策论证，基于现有证据和案例研究。
AI.findings: 赔偿金可以消除黑人与白人之间的财富差距，而投资社区医疗中心和传统黑人大学能够促进早期儿童教育，从而改善教育表现、收入、高等教育参与度等福祉结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合个人赔偿和社区投资的双重补偿框架，扩展了种族不平等和代际流动性的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的实施建议，包括赔偿金支付和针对黑人社区的公共投资策略，以促进种族平等和社会正义。

title: Good to (not) know: A Positive Impact of Non-Financial Uncertainty
affiliations: Université du Havre, Paris Nanterre University and Centre d’Economie de l’Université Paris Nord (CEPN) – UMR 7234 CNRS-Université Sorbonne, Paris 13.

detail.title: Good to (not) know: A Positive Impact of Non-Financial Uncertainty
detail.abstract: We investigate conditions under which uncertainty may have a positive effect on the economy. Contrary to what the few papers that find a positive effect, we conjecture that uncertainty may be positive not only when it is about industrial prospects but more generally when it is non-financial. To argue this, we propose a theoretical intuitive demonstration that may explain why uncertainty may be positive building on recent works on behavioral new Keynesian models: Uncertainty increases agents’ myopia and more myopia helps escape Ricardian equivalence hence implying a more positive impact of a stimulus. Then, the impact of uncertainty shocks according to their nature is studied applying local projection methods in a nonlinear framework. Uncertainty may be non-financial or financial in different regimes of general uncertainty: high, moderate and low. We get a positive and significant effect of the non-financial uncertainty shocks when the general level of uncertainty is high or moderate.

AI.tldr: 本文研究不确定性对经济的正面影响条件，发现非金融不确定性在高或中等总体不确定性水平下具有显著正面效应，这与传统认知相反。
AI.research_question: 不确定性在什么条件下可能对经济产生正面影响？
AI.motivation: 与少数发现不确定性正面效应的文献不同，本文推测不确定性不仅在涉及产业前景时可能产生正面效应，更普遍地，非金融不确定性可能具有正面影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为新凯恩斯主义模型，构建理论直觉论证：不确定性增加代理人的短视行为，更多短视有助于摆脱李嘉图等价，从而增强刺激政策的积极影响。
AI.method: 在非线性框架中应用局部投影方法，研究不同类型不确定性冲击的影响，区分非金融与金融不确定性在不同总体不确定性水平下的效应。
AI.findings: 当总体不确定性水平高或中等时，非金融不确定性冲击具有显著正面效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了不确定性可能通过增加代理人短视行为而产生正面影响的理论机制，扩展了不确定性经济效应的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于不同类型不确定性冲击在不同经济环境下可能产生不同效应的实证依据，有助于更精准的政策干预。

title: Appendix I: IR0–IR3 – From Classical Diplomacy to Algorithmic Governance
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Appendix I: IR0–IR3 – From Classical Diplomacy to Algorithmic Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a theoretical and conceptual work and did not involve human participants or patient data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This appendix explains the foundations of the Third Generation in International Relations (IR3). It shows how international relations moved step by step: from IR1 (sovereignty and institutions) to IR2 (globalization), then IR2⁺ (populist disruption), and finally to IR3 (algorithmic diplomacy). The main idea is simple: earlier generations changed the appearance of diplomacy but not its core. Institutions, globalization, and social media made diplomacy look modern, but wars, inequality, and political bias continued. This is why peace processes often failed. IR3 is different. It places algorithms, digital tools, and symbolic codes at the heart of diplomacy. The goal is not just faster communication, but real reform of the rules of global governance. By combining technology with diplomacy, IR3 offers a new way to deal with today’s challenges—such as cyber conflicts, media influence, and the loss of trust in international institutions. This appendix provides the key terms and ideas needed to follow future studies on IR3. It is both a guide to past failures and a roadmap for building a stronger and fairer system of international relations in the digital age.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了国际关系第三代（IR3）的基础，从IR1（主权与制度）、IR2（全球化）、IR2⁺（民粹主义破坏）到IR3（算法外交）的演变。IR3将算法、数字工具和符号代码置于外交核心，旨在真正改革全球治理规则。
AI.research_question: 国际关系如何从传统外交演变为算法外交？IR3如何通过技术整合解决当代全球挑战？
AI.motivation: 早期国际关系世代（IR1、IR2、IR2⁺）只改变了外交的表象而非核心，导致和平进程失败、战争、不平等和政治偏见持续存在。需要新的方法来应对网络冲突、媒体影响和国际机构信任丧失等挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际关系世代理论：IR1（主权与制度）、IR2（全球化）、IR2⁺（民粹主义破坏）、IR3（算法外交）；算法外交理论；数字治理理论
AI.method: 概念分析框架，通过历史演变分析展示国际关系各世代的特征和局限性
AI.findings: IR3通过将算法和数字工具置于外交核心，提供了改革全球治理规则的新途径，能够更有效地应对网络冲突、媒体操纵和国际信任危机
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了国际关系第三代（IR3）理论框架，建立了算法外交的概念体系，为数字时代的国际关系研究提供了新的理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为构建更强大、更公平的数字时代国际关系体系提供了路线图，指导政策制定者如何整合技术与外交来解决现实全球挑战
